AI.findings: 全球需求冲击对世界工业生产有积极影响，降低石油库存和全球不确定性，改善金融条件。在EMEs中，宏观经济前景向上修正导致工业生产增加、通胀上升、实际汇率升值、EMBI利差降低。石油进口国和出口国之间存在异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了识别全球需求冲击的可靠实证策略，支持理论预期和相关文献，为新兴市场经济体的实证宏观经济建模提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解全球需求冲击对新兴市场经济体的影响提供实证依据，有助于制定应对全球需求波动的宏观经济政策，特别是针对石油进口国和出口国的不同反应。

title: Macro-Criticality of Water Resources
affiliations: , , International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and

detail.title: Macro-Criticality of Water Resources

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the macro-criticality of water resources in the context of climate change. It summarizes the past and future trends of water scarcity and droughts and proposes a framework to analyze the macro-criticality and role of public sector engagement in the water sector. The paper maps out channels through which water resources affect the macro-fiscal and balance of payments positions and develops an understanding of macro-fiscal exposure based on empirical evidence. It also synthesizes emerging insights from IMF-supported operations and capacity development activities, thereby clarifying the rationale and scope for IMF engagement in water-related policy reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究气候变化背景下水资源对宏观经济的关键性影响，提出分析框架，探讨公共部门在水资源管理中的角色，并基于实证证据评估宏观财政风险。
AI.research_question: 水资源在气候变化背景下如何影响宏观经济和财政状况？公共部门应如何参与水资源管理以应对相关风险？
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧水资源短缺和干旱问题，这些水资源挑战对宏观经济稳定、财政可持续性和国际收支平衡构成重大风险，需要系统性分析框架来指导政策应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水资源宏观关键性分析框架，包括水资源对宏观财政和国际收支的影响渠道分析，以及基于实证的宏观财政风险暴露评估理论。
AI.method: 文献综述（总结水资源短缺和干旱的历史与未来趋势），理论框架构建（分析影响渠道），实证证据分析，以及国际货币基金组织（IMF）支持项目和能力建设活动的案例研究。
AI.findings: 水资源短缺和干旱通过多种渠道（如农业生产、能源生产、工业用水、公共卫生等）显著影响宏观经济和财政状况；基于实证证据可以评估各国的宏观财政风险暴露程度；IMF在水资源相关政策改革中具有明确的参与理由和范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了水资源宏观关键性的系统分析框架，明确了水资源对宏观经济影响的具体渠道，为评估气候相关水资源风险的宏观财政影响提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了水资源风险管理工具，明确了IMF在水资源政策改革中的角色和参与范围，为各国应对水资源相关宏观经济风险提供了实践指导。

title: The Food and Agriculture Sector in IMF Publications
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and

detail.title: The Food and Agriculture Sector in IMF Publications

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper presents a text-mining analysis of discussions of food and agriculture issues in publications of the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) from 1946 to mid-2025, with deeper analysis on subsets of this period for selected publication types. It examines how references to food security and agriculture (FSA) have evolved over time, assesses how they differ across IMF outlets and regional focus of the papers, and explores the coverage of subtopics of FSA as well as broader economic contexts within which FSA is contextualized. Using text data from the IMF’s eLibrary metadata as well as its full-text data processed through the use of the Fund Document Extraction Toolkit (FDET), the study identifies key trends in the frequency and intensity of FSA references. The results indicate that IMF attention to FSA issues tends to peak during periods of global food crises and significant agricultural policy changes. These peaks closely track inflationary trends with minimal lag, suggesting rapid response of IMF work to crises. The study also reveals regional variations, with Sub-Saharan Africa and Emerging and Developing Asia exhibiting the highest prevalence of FSA references, while advanced economies show lower prevalence. The analysis also finds that FSA-focused publications exhibit greater attention to selected core macroeconomic themes (inflation and trade) as well as to newer thematic areas (climate change and inequality) relative to other IMF work. The tools and methods can be applied to macrocritical dimensions of other sectoral concerns, and the findings provide a foundation for further research that can extend the methodology and content of this work.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过文本挖掘分析了IMF从1946年到2025年中关于粮食和农业问题的讨论演变，发现IMF对粮食安全的关注度在全球粮食危机和政策变化期间达到峰值，且与通胀趋势高度相关，同时存在明显的区域差异。
AI.research_question: IMF出版物中关于粮食安全和农业问题的讨论如何随时间演变？在不同出版物类型和区域关注点上有何差异？FSA话题如何被置于更广泛的经济背景中讨论？
AI.motivation: 理解IMF作为重要国际金融机构如何关注和处理粮食安全和农业问题，这些问题是全球发展的重要议题，但IMF对这些问题的关注程度和方式尚未得到系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文本挖掘和内容分析的理论框架，结合机构话语分析，探讨国际金融机构对特定经济议题的关注模式及其与宏观经济环境的关联。
AI.method: 使用IMF eLibrary元数据和通过FDET工具处理的全文数据，进行文本挖掘分析，包括频率分析、主题建模和区域比较。
AI.findings: 1. IMF对FSA的关注度在全球粮食危机和重大农业政策变化期间达到峰值；2. 关注度峰值与通胀趋势高度同步，滞后最小；3. 撒哈拉以南非洲和新兴发展中亚洲地区FSA提及率最高；4. FSA相关出版物更关注通胀、贸易等核心宏观经济主题以及气候变化、不平等新议题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了分析国际金融机构对特定经济议题关注模式的方法论框架；2. 揭示了IMF话语与全球危机事件的动态关系；3. 提供了机构议程设置与宏观经济环境关联的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了可应用于其他部门关注的文本分析工具和方法；2. 为政策制定者理解IMF对粮食安全问题的关注模式提供依据；3. 为后续研究扩展方法论和内容奠定基础。

title: Carbon Risk in Loan Pricing
affiliations: King’s College London, International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF)  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Carbon Risk in Loan Pricing

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how carbon risk affects the pricing of U.S. corporate loans and how firms’ and lenders’ commitments influence both loan terms and business decisions. Combining syndicated loan data with firm-level carbon emissions, we document a carbon risk premium: financial institutions charge higher loan risk spreads to borrowers with a higher carbon intensity. This premium varies with the environmental commitments of borrowers and lenders. Borrowers signaling commitments—emission targets, emission disclosures, or green loans—receive discounts that decline with increasing carbon intensity, while committed lenders charge higher interest rates to carbon-intensive borrowers. Beyond affecting the carbon premium, commitments influence real economic outcomes by increasing corporate investment and R&D expenditures, and by reducing precautionary liquidity holdings. We also show that the carbon premium in U.S. loan markets intensifies during periods of monetary tightening in line with the risk-taking channel of monetary policy. Notably, the carbon premium is time varying and has declined in recent years.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了碳风险如何影响美国公司贷款的定价，以及企业和贷款机构的环保承诺如何影响贷款条款和商业决策。研究发现存在碳风险溢价：金融机构对碳强度较高的借款人收取更高的贷款风险利差。这种溢价随借款人和贷款机构的环保承诺而变化，环保承诺会影响实际经济结果，如增加企业投资和研发支出，减少预防性流动性持有。
AI.research_question: 碳风险如何影响美国公司贷款的定价？企业和贷款机构的环保承诺如何影响贷款条款和商业决策？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化问题日益突出，碳风险成为金融市场的重要考量因素。理解碳风险如何影响贷款定价以及环保承诺在其中的作用，对金融机构、企业和政策制定者都具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险定价理论、信号理论和风险承担渠道理论。碳风险被视为一种财务风险，环保承诺作为信号机制影响风险定价，货币政策通过风险承担渠道影响碳风险溢价。
AI.method: 结合银团贷款数据与企业层面碳排放数据，采用实证分析方法研究碳风险溢价及其影响因素。分析环保承诺对贷款定价的影响，并考察其对实际经济结果的作用。
AI.findings:
1. 存在碳风险溢价：金融机构对碳强度较高的借款人收取更高的贷款风险利差。
2. 环保承诺影响溢价：有排放目标、排放披露或绿色贷款的借款人获得折扣，但折扣随碳强度增加而减少；有环保承诺的贷款机构对碳密集型借款人收取更高利率。
3. 环保承诺影响实际经济结果：增加企业投资和研发支出，减少预防性流动性持有。
4. 碳风险溢价随时间变化：在货币政策紧缩时期加剧，近年来有所下降。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将碳风险纳入贷款定价理论框架，扩展了风险定价理论在环境金融领域的应用。
2. 揭示了环保承诺作为信号机制在贷款市场中的作用机制。
3. 验证了货币政策通过风险承担渠道影响碳风险溢价的理论假设。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为金融机构提供了碳风险定价的实证依据，有助于完善贷款风险评估模型。
2. 为企业展示了环保承诺在降低融资成本方面的实际价值。
3. 为政策制定者提供了碳风险与货币政策相互作用的新视角，有助于制定更有效的环境金融政策。

title: AI Meets ESG: Systematic ESG Classification of Shareholder Proposals
affiliations: University of Rhode Island

detail.title: AI Meets ESG: Systematic ESG Classification of Shareholder Proposals
detail.abstract: The classification of shareholder proposals into environmental, social, and governance (ESG) categories by human analysts is subject to ambiguity and inconsistency, which undermines the reliability of empirical research and policy applications. This study introduces a novel approach that leverages large language models’ domain knowledge to systematically categorize shareholder proposals into ESG dimensions. The method minimizes subjectivity in classification and strengthens comparability across studies. Moreover, the framework is fully replicable and adaptable, allowing researchers and practitioners to extend the approach to other ESG-related taxonomies and governance contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种利用大语言模型领域知识对股东提案进行ESG分类的新方法，以减少人工分类的主观性和不一致性，提高实证研究和政策应用的可靠性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型的领域知识，系统地将股东提案分类到ESG维度，以减少人工分类的主观性和不一致性？
AI.motivation: 人工分析师对股东提案进行ESG分类存在模糊性和不一致性，这削弱了实证研究和政策应用的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大语言模型的自然语言处理技术，结合ESG分类框架，构建系统化的股东提案分类方法。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型的领域知识，开发系统化的股东提案ESG分类方法，减少主观性，增强跨研究的可比性。
AI.findings: 该方法能够最小化分类的主观性，增强不同研究之间的可比性，并且框架完全可复制和适应性强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将大语言模型技术应用于ESG分类领域，为股东提案分类提供了新的理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和实践者提供了可复制、可适应的框架，可扩展到其他ESG相关分类体系和治理情境中。

title: Application of PSAK 210 in Disclosure of Events After the Reporting Period to Support Sustainability in Public Companies in Indonesia
affiliations: , Sekolah Tinggi Ilmu Ekonomi Indonesia Jakarta and Sekolah Tinggi Ilmu Ekonomi Indonesia Jakarta

detail.title: Application of PSAK 210 in Disclosure of Events After the Reporting Period to Support Sustainability in Public Companies in Indonesia
detail.abstract: This study aims to analyze the implementation of the Statement of Financial Accounting Standards (PSAK) 210 concerning events after the reporting period and its role in supporting transparency and sustainability in financial reporting among public companies in Indonesia. The research employs a descriptive qualitative approach using a literature study based on previous research findings and official publications from the Indonesian Institute of Accountants (IAI). The results indicate that although PSAK 210 is conceptually aligned with the International Accounting Standard (IAS) 10 issued by the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB), its implementation in Indonesia remains inconsistent. Many public companies disclose post-reporting events only in general terms without providing adequate quantitative details, leading to information asymmetry between companies and investors. The findings imply that effective application of PSAK 210 is essential to strengthen transparency, accountability, and corporate governance. Therefore, improved regulatory oversight, auditor competence, and managerial awareness are required to ensure that post-reporting event disclosures reflect the integrity and sustainability of financial reporting in Indonesia.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印尼上市公司执行PSAK 210（报告期后事项准则）的情况及其对财务报告透明度和可持续性的支持作用。研究发现，尽管PSAK 210在概念上与IAS 10一致，但在印尼的实施仍不一致，许多公司仅提供一般性披露而缺乏定量细节，导致信息不对称。研究强调需要加强监管监督、审计师能力和管理层意识来确保财务报告的完整性。
AI.research_question: PSAK 210（报告期后事项准则）在印尼上市公司的实施情况如何？该准则在支持财务报告透明度和可持续性方面扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于分析PSAK 210的实施情况，因为报告期后事项的适当披露对于财务报告透明度、可持续性和投资者保护至关重要。印尼上市公司在实施该准则时存在不一致性，可能导致信息不对称，影响公司治理和投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究基于国际会计准则（IAS 10）框架，结合信息不对称理论、公司治理理论和财务报告透明度理论。PSAK 210作为印尼版本的IAS 10，为研究提供了理论基础。
AI.method: 采用描述性定性研究方法，通过文献研究分析先前的研究成果和印尼会计师协会（IAI）的官方出版物。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）PSAK 210在概念上与IAS 10一致；2）印尼上市公司的实施不一致；3）许多公司仅提供一般性披露，缺乏充分的定量细节；4）这导致了公司与投资者之间的信息不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）验证了国际会计准则在发展中国家实施的一致性挑战；2）丰富了信息不对称理论在财务报告领域的应用；3）为会计准则实施研究提供了印尼案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）强调了有效应用PSAK 210对增强透明度、问责制和企业治理的重要性；2）提出需要改进监管监督、审计师能力和管理层意识；3）为政策制定者、监管机构和公司提供了改进披露实践的具体建议。

title: ISO 20022 Rich-Data Credit Passport for Thin-File SMEs
affiliations: The University of Lahore Islamabad Campus

detail.title: ISO 20022 Rich-Data Credit Passport for Thin-File SMEs
detail.abstract: MotivationAlthough ISO 20022 introduces rich, structured payment semantics, the credit benefits for thin-file SMEs remain empirically unverified.Data/DesignWe construct a multi-jurisdiction, bank–month panel covering pre- and post-ISO 20022 migrations and develop a Rich-Data Credit Passport (RDCP) that summarizes cash-flow stability, counterparty quality (LEIs), transaction purpose codes, and reconciliation integrity directly observable in ISO messages.MethodsCredit effects are estimated using group-time difference-in-differences and event-study models under staggered adoption, a continuous dose–response framework for RDCP intensity with post-double-selection controls, and dynamic-panel system-GMM to analyze ex-post risk.ResultsAfter ISO 20022 go-live, SME loan rates decline while approval rates increase; non-performing loans fall with a 6–12-month lag. Cross-sectionally, higher RDCP quintiles exhibit stronger model discrimination (AUC/KS ↑), lower funding costs, and reduced collateral haircuts, indicating lower information premia rather than cyclical variation. Results are robust to placebo timing, alternative RDCP constructions, and two-way clustered inference.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了ISO 20022支付标准对中小企业信贷的积极影响，通过构建"丰富数据信用护照"量化支付数据价值，发现采用该标准后中小企业贷款利率下降、审批率提高，且不良贷款率滞后降低。
AI.research_question: ISO 20022支付标准引入的丰富结构化支付语义是否能为"薄档案"中小企业带来实际的信贷效益？
AI.motivation: 尽管ISO 20022引入了丰富的结构化支付语义，但其对薄档案中小企业的信贷效益尚未得到实证验证，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、信贷配给理论、支付数据作为软信息的价值、结构化数据对信贷决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 1) 构建多司法管辖区银行-月度面板数据，覆盖ISO 20022迁移前后时期；2) 开发"丰富数据信用护照"指标，汇总现金流稳定性、交易对手质量、交易目的代码和核对完整性；3) 采用分组时间双重差分法和事件研究法分析交错采用效应；4) 使用连续剂量-反应框架分析RDCP强度；5) 应用动态面板系统GMM方法分析事后风险。
AI.findings: 1) ISO 20022上线后，中小企业贷款利率下降，审批率提高；2) 不良贷款率在6-12个月后下降；3) 较高RDCP五分位数显示更强的模型区分能力，融资成本降低，抵押品折扣减少；4) 结果表明这是信息溢价降低而非周期性变化；5) 结果对安慰剂时间、替代RDCP构建和双向聚类推断具有稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次实证验证ISO 20022支付标准对中小企业信贷的积极影响；2) 提出并验证"丰富数据信用护照"概念，量化支付数据的信贷价值；3) 揭示了结构化支付数据通过降低信息不对称改善信贷条件的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为银行采用ISO 20022标准提供实证支持；2) 为中小企业获得更好信贷条件提供路径；3) 为监管机构推动支付标准现代化提供依据；4) 为金融机构开发基于支付数据的信贷模型提供方法论。

title: Analysing the Application of Behavioural Economics Principles in Zara's Marketing Strategy in India
affiliations: Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce

detail.title: Analysing the Application of Behavioural Economics Principles in Zara's Marketing Strategy in India
detail.abstract: Zara's successful strategies set a valuable example for other brands aiming to achieve and maintain a competitive edge. Zara, a renowned fashion retailer under Inditex, is widely recognized for its products for both men and women. Zara has successfully utilized a combination of traditional marketing methods and behavioral economics principles to boost brand loyalty, increase sales, and improve the overall customer experience. By incorporating tactics like pricing strategies, time-limited promotions, social proof, and choice architecture, Zara has established an appealing shopping environment that connects with consumers both logically and emotionally. Despite strong competitors like H&M, Zara consistently holds the top spot worldwide. Recent data shows Zara's impressive net profit and projected growth, attributed to its strong market presence, sales, and global expansion. With an efficient supply chain and effective positioning, Zara has become a preferred brand. Although Zara is wellestablished, its presence in India is mainly limited to its metropolitan areas, with many consumers unfamiliar with the brand. To reach a wider audience, Zara needs to develop strategies for better consumer acceptance and recognition across the country.

AI.tldr: Zara通过结合传统营销和行为经济学策略（定价、限时促销、社会认同、选择架构）建立了强大的品牌忠诚度和竞争优势，但在印度市场渗透不足，需要制定策略扩大全国影响力。
AI.research_question: Zara如何通过传统营销与行为经济学原则的结合来建立竞争优势和品牌忠诚度？以及如何将其成功策略应用于印度市场以扩大消费者接受度？
AI.motivation: Zara的成功策略为其他品牌提供了有价值的竞争范例，但其在印度市场的有限渗透表明需要制定针对性的市场扩张策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学原理（包括定价策略、限时促销、社会认同理论、选择架构）、传统营销理论、竞争优势理论。
AI.method: 案例分析方法，分析Zara的市场策略、财务数据和全球表现，特别关注其在印度市场的现状和挑战。
AI.findings: Zara成功结合传统营销和行为经济学策略，建立了强大的品牌忠诚度和竞争优势，在全球市场表现优异，但在印度主要限于大都市，消费者认知度有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了行为经济学原理在时尚零售中的实际应用价值，为传统营销与行为经济学的整合提供了实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他时尚品牌提供了可借鉴的成功策略框架，为Zara在印度市场的扩张提供了战略方向建议。

title: Foundation-Model Governance Pathways: From Preference Models to Operative Rules
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: Foundation-Model Governance Pathways: From Preference Models to Operative Rules
detail.abstract:
Current research on foundation model alignment concentrates on preference optimization and reward model design, yet it does not explain how these mechanisms become enforceable linguistic structures in model outputs. This paper introduces a formal bridge between training choices and governance-level effects by defining the operative rule as a compiled constraint that determines which clause types a model may produce. The framework maps policy inputs such as statutes, institutional directives, and redline restrictions into a preference graph over clause types, then compiles those directives into executable constraints that control decoding. It proposes measurable clause-level metrics including coverage, leakage, authority-bearing density, and constraint satisfaction, together with an auditable chain of custody that links governance inputs to observable textual outcomes. Cross-domain simulations in healthcare, securities disclosure, and administrative reporting demonstrate how governance parameters can be enforced without access to proprietary weights. The result is a verifiable clause calculus that operationalizes accountability and replaces abstract alignment narratives with testable governance artifacts connecting preference models to the operative law embedded in generated text.

DOI

  • Primary archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17533075
  • Secondary archive: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.30589940
  • SSRN: Pending assignment (ETA: Q4 2025)

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个形式化框架，将治理政策（如法规、机构指令）映射为可执行的约束，控制基础模型生成特定条款类型，实现从治理输入到文本输出的可验证连接。
AI.research_question: 如何将治理政策（如法规、机构指令）转化为可执行的约束，以控制基础模型生成特定条款类型，并建立从治理输入到文本输出的可验证连接？
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型对齐研究集中于偏好优化和奖励模型设计，但未能解释这些机制如何成为模型输出中可执行的语言结构。需要建立训练选择与治理层面效果之间的形式化桥梁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 操作性规则作为编译约束的概念框架，将政策输入映射为条款类型偏好图，然后编译为控制解码的可执行约束。提出了可验证的条款演算理论。
AI.method: 提出可测量的条款级指标（覆盖率、泄漏率、权威密度、约束满足度）和可审计的监管链。在医疗保健、证券披露和行政报告等领域进行跨领域模拟。
AI.findings: 跨领域模拟表明，无需访问专有权重即可强制执行治理参数。框架能够将治理输入与可观察的文本结果连接起来。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了操作性规则作为编译约束的形式化概念，建立了从治理政策到模型输出的形式化桥梁。发展了可验证的条款演算理论，替代抽象的对齐叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可测量的条款级指标和可审计的监管链，使治理参数可强制执行。框架在医疗、金融、行政等实际领域具有应用价值，增强了模型输出的可问责性。

title: Contextual Determinants of Hurricane Preparedness in a Small Island Developing State: Insights from Hurricane Beryl in St. Vincent and the Grenadines
affiliations: University of the West Indies (Saint Augustine), University of Malta,  and Department of Geography and Geology

detail.title: Contextual Determinants of Hurricane Preparedness in a Small Island Developing State: Insights from Hurricane Beryl in St. Vincent and the Grenadines
detail.abstract: As climate change accelerates, Small Island Developing States (SIDS) are increasingly vulnerable to more frequent and severe hurricanes. This paper examines hurricane preparedness, response, and recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Beryl, which made landfall on July 1, 2024, severely impacting the Southern Grenadines, particularly Union Island, where 90% of structures were reported damaged or destroyed. Drawing on primary data from 150 respondents collected via an online survey, the study explores the interplay between structural vulnerabilities and disaster preparedness in St. Vincent and the Grenadines. While the survey was initially intended for residents directly impacted by the hurricane, displacement and utility disruptions broadened participation to include the wider Vincentian population who experienced the event. Findings challenge dominant assumptions in disaster literature that link preparedness to sociodemographic characteristics and prior disaster experience. Although most respondents demonstrated strong awareness of hurricane risks and reported taking warnings seriously, several barriers, excluding age, gender, or relationship status, hindered effective preparedness. Insecure housing tenure, limited savings, and low insurance coverage emerged as key constraints. These results underscore the importance of viewing preparedness not solely as a matter of individual behaviour, but as a function of broader structural inequities. The study contributes to a growing body of research that reframes disaster preparedness as a development issue and calls for pro-poor, equity-centred resilience strategies, including inclusive insurance schemes, housing support, social protection, and accessible recovery mechanisms. It emphasizes the need for context-specific approaches to disaster risk reduction in SIDS and for embedding equity within climate resilience planning.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了灾害准备与人口特征相关的传统假设，发现住房不安全、储蓄有限和保险覆盖率低是加勒比小岛屿发展中国家有效应对飓风的主要障碍，强调应将灾害准备视为发展问题而非个人行为问题。
AI.research_question: 在圣文森特和格林纳丁斯，结构性脆弱性与灾害准备之间如何相互作用？哪些因素阻碍了小岛屿发展中国家居民的有效飓风准备？
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧导致小岛屿发展中国家面临更频繁严重的飓风威胁，2024年飓风"贝丽尔"造成格林纳丁斯南部特别是联合岛90%建筑受损，迫切需要了解灾害准备的实际障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 挑战传统灾害文献中将准备与人口特征和先前经验联系的假设，采用结构性不平等视角，将灾害准备重新定义为发展问题而非个人行为问题。
AI.method: 通过在线调查收集150名受访者的主要数据，最初针对直接受飓风影响的居民，但因流离失所和公用事业中断而扩展到更广泛的文森特人口。
AI.findings: 尽管大多数受访者对飓风风险有强烈认识并认真对待警告，但年龄、性别或关系状况以外的因素阻碍了有效准备。住房不安全、储蓄有限和保险覆盖率低是关键约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战灾害准备与人口特征相关的传统假设，将灾害准备重新定义为结构性不平等问题而非个人行为问题，为小岛屿发展中国家灾害风险减少提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁采取亲贫、以公平为中心的韧性策略，包括包容性保险计划、住房支持、社会保护和可及恢复机制，强调小岛屿发展中国家需要特定情境的灾害风险减少方法。

title: Exposure of Termites and Associated Microbiomes to Soil Mercury in a tropical rainforest (French Guiana)
affiliations: , , Université Paris-Saclay, INRAE, AgroParisTech, UMR SayFood,, University Paris-Est Créteil Val de Marne, , University Paris-Est Créteil Val de Marne, University Paris-Est Créteil Val de Marne, University Paris-Est Créteil Val de Marne, Sorbonne University - Institut de Recherche pour le Développement,  and University Paris-Est Créteil Val de Marne

detail.title: Exposure of Termites and Associated Microbiomes to Soil Mercury in a tropical rainforest (French Guiana)
detail.abstract: Mercury (Hg) pollution is a major concern, especially in tropical regions where artisanal and small-scale gold mining exacerbates the problem, yet its impacts on terrestrial fauna remain understudied. To assess termite exposure to Hg, we compared total Hg (THg), methylmercury (MeHg), and associated microbiomes in soil-feeders (Anoplotermes, Termes) and the wood-feeder Nasutitermes from French Guiana, along with their nests and adjacent soils. A 14-19-fold THg enrichment was observed in soil feeder bodies relative to soils and nests, compared with only 1.3-3-fold in Nasutitermes. Similarly, MeHg concentrations were higher in soil feeders, peaking in Anoplotermes and decreasing in genera with reduced soil intake. Soil-feeder gut microbiomes showed higher α-diversity than surrounding habitats. qPCR revealed higher abundances of bacteria, Hg-methylators (hgcA), and Hg-reducers (merA) in guts than in soils, with positive correlations suggesting density-dependent variation in functional groups. Gene copy numbers across compartments correlated with THg but not with body MeHg, while both Hg species influenced bacterial community structure and correlated positively with 16S rRNA OTU richness. The mechanisms underlying these relationships remain unclear. This first assessment of Hg-methylator diversity in termites reveals Desulfobacterota-related methylators as dominant in soils and nests, while Bacillota-related taxa prevail in guts with marked genus-specificity. This suggests that, with their high diversity, Isopteran guts represent a major reservoir of endemic Hg-methylators. With their prevalence and propensity to accumulate large amounts of THg and MeHg, soil-feeding termites may act as conduits of Hg to higher trophic levels and serve as effective terrestrial bioindicators of mercury exposure.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次评估了热带地区白蚁对汞污染的暴露情况，发现土壤食性白蚁比木材食性白蚁积累了更高浓度的总汞和甲基汞，其肠道微生物群是汞甲基化菌的重要储存库，可能成为汞向更高营养级传递的通道和有效的陆地生物指示剂。
AI.research_question: 热带地区白蚁如何暴露于汞污染？不同食性白蚁（土壤食性与木材食性）在汞积累、甲基汞浓度和微生物群落方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 汞污染在热带地区是一个严重问题，特别是手工和小规模金矿开采加剧了这一问题，但其对陆地动物的影响研究不足。白蚁作为热带生态系统中的重要分解者，可能成为汞污染的重要指示生物和传播途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于汞生物地球化学循环理论，结合微生物生态学，研究汞在不同环境介质（土壤、巢穴、白蚁）中的迁移转化，以及汞甲基化菌和汞还原菌在汞形态转化中的作用。
AI.method: 在法属圭亚那采集土壤食性白蚁（Anoplotermes, Termes）和木材食性白蚁（Nasutitermes）及其巢穴和相邻土壤样本；测定总汞和甲基汞浓度；分析微生物群落多样性；使用qPCR定量细菌、汞甲基化基因（hgcA）和汞还原基因（merA）的丰度。
AI.findings: 1. 土壤食性白蚁体内总汞富集14-19倍，而木材食性白蚁仅富集1.3-3倍；2. 甲基汞浓度在土壤食性白蚁中更高，在Anoplotermes中达到峰值；3. 土壤食性白蚁肠道微生物α多样性高于周围环境；4. 肠道中细菌、hgcA和merA基因丰度高于土壤；5. Desulfobacterota相关甲基化菌在土壤和巢穴中占主导，而Bacillota相关类群在肠道中占优势且具有属特异性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示了白蚁肠道作为汞甲基化菌重要储存库的生态功能；提出了白蚁肠道微生物群在汞生物地球化学循环中的新作用；为理解汞在陆地食物网中的传递机制提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 土壤食性白蚁可作为有效的陆地汞污染生物指示剂；白蚁可能成为汞向更高营养级传递的重要通道；为热带地区汞污染监测和风险评估提供了新工具；对金矿开采区的生态风险评估具有重要参考价值。

title: Investment Lessons from Cosmology: “Draw Your Assumptions Before Your Conclusions”
affiliations: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Cornell University - Operations Research & Industrial Engineering

detail.title: Investment Lessons from Cosmology: “Draw Your Assumptions Before Your Conclusions”
detail.abstract:
•Every student of statistics learns that correlation does not imply causation
–Association is an observational property
–Causation is an interventional concept
•Causality plays a fundamental role in the scientific method
–Scientific theories are falsifiable statements of the form “X causes Y through mechanism M”
•Much of modern scientific research is false due to the “replication crisis”:
–Type-A Spuriosity: Statistical flukes
–Type-B Spuriosity: Non-causal association
•Recent developments in Cosmology demonstrate the power of Causal Inference to prevent false discoveries
–Similarities between Cosmology and Financial Research provide lessons about what (and what not) to do when developing investment strategies
–In the words of Prof. Miguel Hernán, “draw your assumptions before your conclusions”

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了相关性不等于因果性这一统计基本原则，分析了现代科学研究中的"可重复性危机"问题，特别是两种类型的虚假关联（统计偶然性和非因果关联），并通过宇宙学和金融研究的案例展示了因果推断在防止虚假发现中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 因果推断如何帮助解决现代科学研究中的"可重复性危机"，特别是在金融投资策略开发中如何应用因果推断来防止虚假发现？
AI.motivation: 现代科学研究面临严重的"可重复性危机"，许多研究发现无法被重复验证。这种危机主要源于两种类型的虚假关联：统计偶然性（Type-A Spuriosity）和非因果关联（Type-B Spuriosity）。需要开发有效的方法来区分相关性和因果性，以提高科学发现的可信度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 因果推断理论：区分观察性关联和干预性因果关系；2. 科学方法论：科学理论是可证伪的"X通过机制M导致Y"的陈述；3. 虚假关联分类学：Type-A Spuriosity（统计偶然性）和Type-B Spuriosity（非因果关联）；4. 宇宙学与金融研究的类比框架。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析和案例研究方法：1. 分析相关性不等于因果性的统计原则；2. 探讨"可重复性危机"的根源；3. 通过宇宙学中因果推断的成功应用案例；4. 类比宇宙学与金融研究的相似性，提出金融投资策略开发中的因果推断应用建议。
AI.findings: 1. 相关性是观察性属性，而因果性是干预性概念，两者本质不同；2. 现代科学研究的虚假发现主要源于两种虚假关联；3. 宇宙学领域通过因果推断成功防止了虚假发现；4. 金融研究与宇宙学在方法论上具有相似性，可以借鉴因果推断方法；5. "先画假设，再得结论"是有效应用因果推断的关键原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统阐述了相关性不等于因果性的深层理论含义；2. 提出了虚假关联的两种类型分类框架；3. 建立了宇宙学与金融研究的方法论类比理论；4. 强调了因果推断在科学方法论中的核心地位；5. 为跨学科应用因果推断提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融投资策略开发提供了防止虚假发现的实用方法；2. 提出了"先画假设，再得结论"的操作原则；3. 展示了如何将宇宙学中的因果推断技术应用于金融研究；4. 为科研人员提供了识别和避免虚假关联的具体指导；5. 有助于提高投资策略的科学性和可重复性。

title: Taxing Mobile Money
affiliations: , International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Fiscal Affairs Department, Université d'Auvergne - Clermont 1, Centre d'Etudes et de Recherches sur le Developpement International (CERDI), Students and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Taxing Mobile Money

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Mobile money has become a central digital alternative to traditional banking in developing countries, yet several African governments have introduced taxes on mobile money transactions. We develop a model that characterizes how such taxes affect payment choices and generate excess burden. The model predicts that taxation reduces mobile money use, with elasticities shaped by access to substitutes and transaction costs: banked users substitute into formal alternatives, while unbanked users face higher effective costs, making the tax regressive. Taxation also induces substitution into cash, raising informality. We empirically test these predictions using cross-country survey data and novel transaction-level data from Cameroon, the Central African Republic, and Mali. Results show sharp declines in mobile money usage, with stronger responses among the banked. Unbanked and rural users bear a disproportionate burden. We use the empirical estimates to gauge the excess burden of the tax, which we quantify at 35% of revenue—highlighting its significant efficiency cost alongside its regressive impact.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了非洲国家对移动货币征税的影响，发现税收会减少移动货币使用，对无银行账户和农村用户造成不成比例的负担，并导致35%的超额负担效率成本。
AI.research_question: 移动货币税收如何影响支付选择、产生超额负担，以及对不同用户群体（有银行账户vs无银行账户）的分配效应？
AI.motivation: 移动货币已成为发展中国家传统银行的重要数字替代方案，但多个非洲政府开始对移动货币交易征税。需要理解这种税收对支付行为、效率成本和分配公平的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于支付选择模型，考虑替代品可得性和交易成本。税收通过改变相对价格影响支付决策，有银行账户用户可转向正规替代品，无银行账户用户面临更高有效成本。
AI.method: 理论模型开发结合实证检验：使用跨国调查数据和来自喀麦隆、中非共和国、马里的交易级数据进行实证分析，量化税收影响和超额负担。
AI.findings: 税收显著减少移动货币使用，有银行账户用户反应更强（可转向银行服务）。无银行账户和农村用户承担不成比例负担，税收具有累退性。税收还导致现金使用增加，提高非正规性。超额负担占税收收入的35%。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了分析移动货币税收影响的理论框架，阐明了替代品可得性和交易成本在塑造税收弹性中的作用，揭示了税收对支付系统发展的潜在阻碍效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据：移动货币税收具有显著的效率成本和累退性分配效应，建议考虑更公平的税收设计或替代性财政工具，以支持金融包容性。

title: Emerging Market Resilience
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF), Warsaw School of Economics (SGH), International Monetary Fund, International Monetary Fund (IMF) and

detail.title: Emerging Market Resilience

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Emerging markets have shown remarkable resilience during risk-off episodes in recent years. While favorable external conditions—good luck—contributed to this resilience, improvements inpolicy frameworks—good policies—played a critical role in bolstering the capacity of emerging markets to withstand the adverse consequences of these events. Improvements in monetary policy implementation and credibility have reduced reliance on foreign exchange (FX) interventions and capital flow management measures, and stricter macroprudential regulation also contributedto less FX interventions. Also, central banks have become less sensitive to fiscal interference and hold sway over domestic borrowing conditions. Looking ahead, countries with robust frameworks face easier policy trade-offs and are better positioned to navigate risk-off episodes. In contrast, economies with weaker frameworks risk de-anchoring inflation expectations and larger output losses if monetary tightening is delayed, especially when persistent price pressures emerge. In these settings, FX interventions offer only temporary relief and are less necessary when policy frameworks are sound.

AI.tldr: 新兴市场在风险规避时期表现出显著韧性，这既得益于有利的外部条件（好运），也源于政策框架的改进（好政策）。货币政策实施和可信度的提升减少了对汇率干预和资本流动管理措施的依赖，更严格的宏观审慎监管也减少了汇率干预。央行对财政干预的敏感性降低，并对国内借贷条件有更大影响力。展望未来，拥有稳健框架的国家面临更轻松的政策权衡，能更好地应对风险规避时期；而框架较弱的经济体如果延迟货币紧缩，特别是在持续价格压力出现时，可能面临通胀预期脱锚和更大的产出损失。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场在风险规避时期表现出的韧性主要归因于哪些因素？政策框架改进如何影响新兴市场应对风险规避事件的能力？
AI.motivation: 近年来新兴市场在风险规避时期表现出令人惊讶的韧性，这引发了对其背后原因的探究。理解"好运"（有利外部条件）和"好政策"（政策框架改进）各自的作用，对于评估新兴市场的政策有效性和未来风险应对能力至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济政策框架理论，特别是货币政策可信度理论、汇率干预理论和宏观审慎监管理论。强调政策框架质量对经济韧性的影响，区分外部条件（好运）与内部政策改进（好政策）的作用。
AI.method: 基于观察性分析和政策评估方法，通过分析新兴市场近年来的表现和政策演变，评估不同因素对经济韧性的贡献。采用比较分析方法，对比不同政策框架国家的表现。
AI.findings: 1. 新兴市场的韧性既来自有利的外部条件，也来自政策框架的实质性改进；2. 货币政策实施和可信度的提升减少了对汇率干预和资本流动管理措施的依赖；3. 更严格的宏观审慎监管也减少了汇率干预需求；4. 央行对财政干预的敏感性降低，对国内借贷条件的影响力增强；5. 稳健的政策框架使国家面临更轻松的政策权衡，能更好地应对风险规避时期。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对新兴市场经济韧性来源的理解，区分了"好运"和"好政策"的作用；2. 强调了政策框架质量在决定经济应对风险能力中的核心作用；3. 提供了关于货币政策可信度、汇率干预和宏观审慎监管之间相互作用的新见解；4. 建立了政策框架稳健性与政策权衡难度之间的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为新兴市场政策制定者提供了改进政策框架的具体方向；2. 强调了建立稳健货币政策框架的重要性，特别是在通胀预期管理方面；3. 指出汇率干预只能提供临时缓解，不能替代健全的政策框架；4. 为国际金融机构评估新兴市场风险提供分析框架；5. 帮助投资者更好地评估不同新兴市场经济体的风险状况。

title: Trust, Confidence, and Consumption Resilience: A Quasi-natural Experiment Based on the Rural E-Commerce Demonstration County policy
affiliations: Ningbo University of Finance and Economics, Shanghai Normal University and Anhui University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Trust, Confidence, and Consumption Resilience: A Quasi-natural Experiment Based on the Rural E-Commerce Demonstration County policy

keywords: The Rural E-Commerce Demonstration County policy

detail.abstract: This study leverages China’s Rural E-Commerce Demonstration County (REDC) policy as a quasi-natural experiment to examine how digital economics enhances rural household consumption resilience amid economic shocks. Using longitudinal data (CFPS, 2010–2018) from 11,518 households and staggered difference-in-differences models with robustness checks (parallel trends, placebo tests, and controls for concurrent policies), we quantify resilience through a multidimensional index. Results show REDC implementation increases per capita consumption resilience by 48–53%, with stronger effects in populous/commercial areas but equitable benefits across demographics. Trust-building (via secure platforms/logistics) and future confidence (from income diversification) are identified as dual mechanisms explaining 65–72% of gains. As the first causal evidence linking e-commerce to micro-level resilience, this research advances policy evaluation methodologies through entropy-weighted indices while revealing institutional-behavioral pathways. Practical implications emphasize prioritizing last-mile logistics, gender-targeted digital literacy programs, and blockchain traceability systems to sustain inclusive growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用中国"农村电子商务示范县"政策作为准自然实验，发现电商发展能显著提升农村家庭消费韧性48-53%，主要通过信任构建（安全平台/物流）和未来信心（收入多元化）双重机制实现。
AI.research_question: 数字经济如何增强农村家庭在经济冲击下的消费韧性？
AI.motivation: 在经济冲击频发的背景下，理解如何增强农村家庭消费韧性对促进包容性增长至关重要，但数字经济对微观层面消费韧性的因果效应尚缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于准自然实验设计，结合制度经济学和行为经济学理论，构建信任构建和未来信心的双重机制框架来解释数字经济对消费韧性的影响。
AI.method: 使用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）2010-2018年11,518户家庭的纵向数据，采用交错双重差分模型，通过平行趋势检验、安慰剂测试和同期政策控制进行稳健性检验，使用熵权法构建多维消费韧性指数。
AI.findings: 农村电商示范县政策实施使人均消费韧性提升48-53%，在人口密集/商业发达地区效果更强，但各人口群体均能平等受益；信任构建和未来信心双重机制解释了65-72%的增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了电商对微观层面消费韧性的因果证据；通过熵权指数推进政策评估方法学；揭示了制度-行为双重作用路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调优先发展"最后一公里"物流、性别针对性数字素养项目、区块链溯源系统，以维持包容性增长。

title: The Dynamics of Sovereign Debt Spreads: A Comparative Study of Core and Peripheral Euro Area Economies
affiliations: Central Bank of Malta, Central Bank of Malta and Central Bank of Malta

detail.title: The Dynamics of Sovereign Debt Spreads: A Comparative Study of Core and Peripheral Euro Area Economies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Malta Research Paper Series
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Malta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper explores the evolution and determinants of sovereign debt spreads within the euro area. The analysis focuses on how a broad range of factors influenced borrowing costs for both core and peripheral member states from the run-up to the monetary union till the end of the third quarter of 2025. It traces the transition from the pre-crisis era of convergence, when sovereign risks were viewed as homogeneous, to subsequent periods of market divergence and revaluation of risk across member states. By going through periods of convergence and fragmentation, the paper demonstrates how key events governed investor perceptions and borrowing costs. The pivotal role of the European Central Bank in safeguarding monetary policy transmission and maintaining financial stability is highlighted. Notably, the research suggests that country-specific fundamentals have increasingly gained importance in investor risk assessments, challenging the usefulness of core-periphery labels. Additionally, recent sovereign spreads may more accurately reflect differentiated national risk profiles compared to the highly converged trading observed during the early years of the monetary union. While the overall range of yields has tightened, current spreads remain wider. This may indicate a more nuanced form of financial integration, one that acknowledges persistent country-specific risks and possible structural vulnerabilities within the euro area.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了欧元区主权债务利差的演变和决定因素，追踪了从货币联盟成立前到2025年第三季度期间核心与外围成员国借贷成本的变化。研究发现，国家特定基本面因素在投资者风险评估中的重要性日益增加，挑战了核心-外围标签的有效性，表明当前利差可能更准确地反映了差异化的国家风险状况。
AI.research_question: 欧元区主权债务利差的演变和决定因素是什么？从货币联盟成立前到2025年第三季度，哪些因素影响了核心和外围成员国的借贷成本？
AI.motivation: 理解欧元区主权债务市场从危机前趋同时期（主权风险被视为同质）到后续市场分化和成员国风险重新评估的转变过程，以及关键事件如何影响投资者认知和借贷成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权债务利差决定因素理论，包括国家基本面、市场整合与分化理论，欧洲央行在维护货币政策传导和金融稳定中的作用，以及核心-外围分析框架的有效性。
AI.method: 对欧元区主权债务利差从货币联盟成立前到2025年第三季度的演变进行时间序列分析，比较核心与外围成员国，识别关键影响因素和转折点。
AI.findings: 1. 国家特定基本面因素在投资者风险评估中的重要性日益增加；2. 核心-外围标签的有用性受到挑战；3. 当前主权利差比货币联盟早期高度趋同的交易更能准确反映差异化的国家风险状况；4. 虽然整体收益率区间收窄，但当前利差仍然较宽；5. 欧洲央行在维护货币政策传导和金融稳定方面发挥了关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统的核心-外围分析框架，提出了更精细化的金融整合概念，强调国家特定风险在欧元区主权债务定价中的持久重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于欧元区主权债务市场演变和风险定价的见解，有助于更准确地评估国家风险，指导欧洲央行的政策干预，并为投资者提供更精细化的风险评估框架。

title: Collateral and Credit
affiliations: KU Leuven - Department of Accountancy, Finance and Insurance (AFI), Tilburg University - Department of Finance, Research Department, KU Leuven - Department of Accountancy, Finance and Insurance (AFI) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Collateral and Credit

publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies the role of collateral using the euro area corporate credit registry, Ana-Credit. We document key facts about the importance, distribution, and composition of collateral, including its presence, types, and values. On average, 70 % of credit amounts are collateralized. Real estate and financial assets are the most pledged, while physical movable assets and other intangible assets are less present. In addition, we show that the aggregate collateral value pledged to the banking sector is substantial, driven mainly by real estate in most countries. For the first time, we examine the collateral channel in bank credit using the actual value of individual collateral. By exploiting within- firm and within-bank variations for newly issued secured loans, we find that the elasticity of collateral value to loan commitment amounts is around 0.7-0.8. This collateral value elasticity exhibits substantial country and time heterogeneity, which can be explained by legal, financial, and macro conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用欧元区企业信贷登记系统Ana-Credit分析抵押品的作用，发现约70%的信贷金额有抵押，房地产和金融资产是最主要的抵押类型。研究首次使用个体抵押品实际价值检验银行信贷中的抵押渠道，发现抵押品价值对贷款承诺金额的弹性约为0.7-0.8，且存在显著的国家和时间异质性。
AI.research_question: 抵押品在银行信贷中扮演什么角色？抵押品价值如何影响贷款承诺金额？抵押渠道的效应在不同国家和时间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 虽然抵押品在信贷市场中至关重要，但缺乏关于抵押品实际价值、类型分布及其对信贷供给影响的系统性证据。欧元区企业信贷登记系统Ana-Credit提供了独特的数据机会来填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷渠道理论，特别是抵押渠道理论，研究抵押品价值变化如何通过影响借款人的净值和银行的信贷供给来传导货币政策和经济冲击。
AI.method: 使用欧元区企业信贷登记系统Ana-Credit的微观数据，采用企业和银行内部变异的识别策略，分析新发放担保贷款中抵押品价值与贷款承诺金额的关系。
AI.findings: 1) 平均70%的信贷金额有抵押；2) 房地产和金融资产是最主要的抵押类型；3) 抵押品价值对贷款承诺金额的弹性约为0.7-0.8；4) 该弹性存在显著的国家和时间异质性，受法律、金融和宏观经济条件影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次使用个体抵押品实际价值实证检验抵押渠道，为信贷渠道理论提供微观证据，揭示了抵押品价值与信贷供给之间的数量关系及其异质性决定因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估金融稳定风险提供依据，帮助银行优化抵押品管理策略，为政策制定者设计逆周期宏观审慎政策提供参考，特别是针对房地产抵押品的重要性。

title: Intangible Capital with Synergy and Scalability: A New Measurement Framework
affiliations: Singapore Institute of Technology and University of Calgary - Haskayne School of Business

detail.title: Intangible Capital with Synergy and Scalability: A New Measurement Framework
detail.abstract: Scalability, the ability to expand output at low marginal cost, and synergy, the ability to combine resources to generate convex payoffs, are widely viewed as the defining features of intangible capital. Yet the current empirical measures of intangible capital implicitly rule out scalability and synergy payoffs. They rigidly mirror perpetual inventory models, created for physical capital, to linearly accumulate and amortize past research and development and selling, general, and administrative outlays. We relax these restrictions by allowing a dollar of intangible investment to generate value greater than its initial cost and by permitting investments to interact nonlinearly. We train prediction models using purchase price allocations to identifiable intangible assets in 1,533 mergers and acquisitions transactions. We apply the trained model to a broader sample of Compustat firms to estimate their intangible capital. Augmented book values of assets and equity with our estimates deliver a dramatic improvement in out-of-sample predictions of enterprise values, intrinsic returns, and patent values. We contribute to the literature by operationalizing, and proposing a method for estimating, scalability and synergy, concepts emphasized in theoretical literature, but largely ignored in firm-level estimates of internally generated intangibles.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种新的无形资产估算方法，突破了传统线性累积模型的限制，允许无形资产具有规模效应和协同效应，显著提升了企业价值、内在回报和专利价值的预测能力。
AI.research_question: 如何操作化并估算无形资产的可扩展性和协同效应，以更准确地衡量企业价值？
AI.motivation: 当前无形资产的经验测量方法（基于物理资本的永续盘存模型）排除了可扩展性和协同效应的可能性，无法捕捉无形资产的真实价值创造特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无形资产理论强调可扩展性（以低边际成本扩大产出的能力）和协同效应（资源组合产生凸性回报的能力）是其定义性特征。
AI.method: 使用1,533个并购交易中的可识别无形资产购买价格分配数据训练预测模型，然后将训练好的模型应用于更广泛的Compustat公司样本，估算其无形资产。
AI.findings: 使用我们的无形资产估算方法增强的资产和权益账面价值，在预测企业价值、内在回报和专利价值方面实现了显著的样本外预测改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 将理论文献中强调但企业层面无形资产估算中基本忽略的可扩展性和协同效应概念操作化，并提出了估算方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了更准确的无形资产估算工具，显著提升了企业估值、投资回报预测和专利价值评估的准确性。

keywords: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union

detail.abstract: The Antin v. Spain case demonstrates the collision between the primacy of the ICSID Convention and the doctrine of autonomy of EU Law. It shows that the European Commission, using competition law as an enforcement tool, can de facto neutralize investment arbitration within its territory, forcing Member States into non-compliance with international law.

AI.tldr: 《Antin v. Spain案揭示了ICSID公约优先性与欧盟法自治原则的冲突，表明欧盟委员会可利用竞争法作为执法工具，在事实上使投资仲裁在其境内失效，迫使成员国违反国际法义务。
AI.research_question: 欧盟法自治原则与ICSID公约优先性之间的冲突如何影响投资仲裁在欧盟境内的执行？欧盟委员会使用竞争法作为执法工具如何导致成员国违反国际法义务？
AI.motivation: Antin v. Spain案揭示了国际投资法与欧盟法之间的根本性冲突，这种冲突不仅影响具体案件的执行，更威胁到国际投资仲裁体系的完整性。欧盟委员会通过竞争法干预投资仲裁的做法，可能为其他司法管辖区提供规避国际义务的先例。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 国际法优先原则（ICSID公约第53、54条）
2. 欧盟法自治原则（CJEU判例法）
3. 竞争法作为执法工具的理论
4. 国际法与国内法冲突理论
5. 投资仲裁执行机制理论
AI.method: 案例分析法：深入分析Antin v. Spain案的具体事实、法律争议和裁决结果；比较法研究：对比ICSID公约与欧盟法的相关规定；文献分析法：梳理相关学术文献和判例法。
AI.findings:
1. 欧盟委员会通过竞争法干预，实际上使ICSID裁决在欧盟境内无法执行
2. 成员国面临"遵守欧盟法"与"履行国际义务"的两难困境
3. 这种冲突不仅限于西班牙，可能影响所有欧盟成员国
4. 竞争法成为欧盟规避国际投资义务的有效工具
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"竞争法作为国际法规避工具"的新理论框架
2. 深化了对国际法与区域法冲突机制的理解
3. 揭示了欧盟法自治原则的实际边界和影响
4. 为国际投资法与区域法协调提供了新的分析视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者提供了在欧盟投资的风险警示
2. 为成员国政府指出了法律合规的潜在冲突
3. 为国际仲裁机构提供了处理类似冲突的参考
4. 为欧盟委员会的政策制定提供了反思依据
5. 为国际投资条约的修订提供了实践启示

title: Social Class in the U.S.: Polarization, Inequality, and Mobility
affiliations: California State University, San Bernardino - Department of Economics

detail.title: Social Class in the U.S.: Polarization, Inequality, and Mobility
detail.abstract: While social class is often used to explain economic outcomes and trends, identifying individuals' precise location within the class structure remains challenging. This paper proposes a novel approach to class structure and using a panel survey to analyze class location in the United States. Drawing on the Marxian concept of class, this study analyzes class polarization, intrapersonal mobility, and inequalities both between and within classes. We find that polarization and mobility are linked to growth patterns, yet many inequalities persist, diverging from macroeconomic fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于马克思主义阶级概念的新方法来识别美国阶级结构，分析阶级极化、个人内部流动性和阶级间/内部不平等，发现极化与流动性跟增长模式相关，但许多不平等现象持续存在且与宏观经济波动脱节。
AI.research_question: 如何准确识别个体在阶级结构中的位置？阶级极化、个人内部流动性和阶级间/内部不平等在美国如何表现？这些现象与经济增长模式有何关系？
AI.motivation: 虽然社会阶级常被用来解释经济结果和趋势，但准确识别个体在阶级结构中的具体位置仍然具有挑战性。现有方法难以精确测量阶级位置，需要新的分析框架来研究阶级动态和不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于马克思主义的阶级概念，强调阶级作为社会关系和生产关系中的位置，而非简单的收入或职业分类。关注阶级极化、个人内部流动性和阶级间/内部不平等。
AI.method: 使用面板调查数据，提出新颖的阶级结构分析方法，对美国阶级位置进行实证分析。通过纵向数据追踪个体阶级位置变化。
AI.findings: 1. 阶级极化和个人内部流动性与经济增长模式相关；2. 许多不平等现象持续存在，与宏观经济波动趋势不一致；3. 阶级间和阶级内部都存在显著的不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了基于马克思主义阶级概念的新分析框架；2. 提供了更精确的阶级位置识别方法；3. 深化了对阶级动态与经济增长关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供更准确的阶级结构分析工具；2. 帮助理解不平等现象的持久性；3. 为评估经济政策对阶级结构的影响提供实证基础。

detail.abstract: In this note, we describe SONIA futures, as traded on CurveGlobal, and the associated convexity adjustment. We provide a risk management analysis of the futures by comparison to standard OISs and other overnight-indexed financial instruments. We explain why in comparison to LIBOR futures, SONIA futures provide a better risk management tool. The cost saving originating in margin offset available at LCH between cleared swaps and exchange traded futures is also investigated.

AI.tldr: 本文分析SONIA期货及其凸性调整，通过与标准OIS和其他隔夜指数金融工具比较进行风险管理分析，说明SONIA期货相比LIBOR期货是更好的风险管理工具，并研究LCH清算互换与交易所期货之间的保证金抵消带来的成本节约。

AI.motivation: 随着LIBOR逐步退出市场，SONIA作为英镑隔夜指数的重要性日益增加。需要评估SONIA期货作为风险管理工具的有效性，以及其在成本节约方面的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凸性调整理论、风险管理理论、期货定价理论、保证金抵消机制理论
AI.method: 比较分析法：将SONIA期货与标准OIS、其他隔夜指数金融工具、LIBOR期货进行比较分析；风险管理分析；成本效益分析
AI.findings: 1. SONIA期货相比LIBOR期货提供更好的风险管理工具；2. 凸性调整对SONIA期货定价和风险管理至关重要；3. LCH清算互换与交易所期货之间的保证金抵消能带来显著成本节约

publicationDetails.detailsText: HANDBOOK ON THE INTERNATIONAL POLITICAL ECONOMY OF CHINA, Zeng Ka, ed., 2nd edn, Edward Elgar Publishing, 2026, Forthcoming

publicationDetails.detailsText: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 25-92

detail.abstract:
This chapter examines China's continuous rise in the international intellectual property regime. It begins by revisiting the typology scholars have used to determine the levels at which a country engages with international norms: (1) norm breaker, (2) norm taker, (3) norm shaker and (4) norm maker. Although China has been widely considered a norm breaker or a norm taker in the intellectual property arena, the past two decades have seen China joining other like-minded countries in shaking multilateral norms. In recent years, China has also become a norm maker, ushering in new, unique policy and regulatory approaches to tackle global problems, which ranged from the COVID-19 pandemic to AI technology.
This chapter then examines four notable developments that have enabled China to shape future international intellectual property and innovation norms: (1) the negotiation of the RCEP and other nonmultilateral trade agreements, (2) the establishment of the BRI, (3) the launch of active vaccine diplomacy during the COVID-19 pandemic and (4) the assumption of global leadership in shaping AI technology and the related international regulatory environment.
The chapter further explains why China has decided to become more assertive in the intellectual property arena—a curious position for a country that has been long considered a norm breaker and a norm taker in this arena. This chapter concludes by revisiting the four questions I identified for future research in the first edition of this Handbook. The discussion explores whether these questions are still valid today—and, if so, whether the questions will yield new answers, based on China's recent developments in the intellectual property arena.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨中国在国际知识产权制度中的角色演变，从规范破坏者/接受者转变为规范动摇者和制定者，并分析推动这一转变的四个关键因素。
AI.research_question: 中国如何从国际知识产权制度的规范破坏者/接受者转变为规范动摇者和制定者？推动这一转变的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解中国在国际知识产权制度中角色的转变，以及这种转变对全球知识产权和创新规范的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际规范参与类型学：规范破坏者、规范接受者、规范动摇者、规范制定者。
AI.method: 文献回顾与案例分析，考察四个关键发展：RCEP等贸易协定、一带一路倡议、疫苗外交、AI技术领导地位。
AI.findings: 中国已从规范破坏者/接受者转变为规范动摇者和制定者；四个关键发展推动了中国在国际知识产权制度中的角色转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了国际规范参与类型学理论，提供了中国在国际知识产权制度中角色转变的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解中国在国际知识产权制度中的战略转变提供参考，有助于预测未来国际知识产权规范的发展方向。

detail.title: Is Jobless Growth Valid in Türkiye? A Sectoral Analysis of the Relationship between Unemployment and Economic Growth

publicationDetails.detailsText: Optimum Ekonomi ve Yönetim Bilimleri Dergisi, volume 12, issue 2, 2025[10.17541/optimum.1640550]

detail.abstract:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PLEASE CITE THE PUBLISHED VERSION:

Akusta, E. (2025). Is jobless growth valid in Türkiye? A sectoral analysis of the relationship between unemployment and economic growth. Optimum Journal of Economics and Management Sciences, 12(2), 469–486. https://doi.org/10.17541/optimum.1640550

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


This study analyzes the validity of jobless growth in Türkiye on sectoral basis. It analyzes the impacts of agriculture, industry, construction and services sectors on unemployment using annual data for the period 2000-2022. ARDL method is applied within the scope of the analysis. The findings are tested with FMOLS and CCR methods. The results show that growth in all sectors reduces the unemployment. A one-unit increase in the share of agriculture sector in GDP decreases the unemployment rate by 0.471 points, 0.680 points in the industrial sector, 0.899 points in the construction sector and 1.383 points in the services sector in the short-run. The long-run coefficients reveal that the impacts of sectoral growth on unemployment are stronger in the long-run than in the short-run. A one unit increase in the share of the agricultural sector in GDP decreases the unemployment rate by 2.380 points, 4.057 points in the industrial sector, 1.761 points in the construction sector and 3.664 points in the services sector in the long-run. These findings show that jobless growth is not valid in Türkiye in general. On the contrary, economic growth plays an important role in reducing unemployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了土耳其是否存在无就业增长现象，通过部门分析发现所有部门的增长都能减少失业，服务业对降低失业率的影响最大，短期和长期效应均显著，证明土耳其不存在无就业增长。
AI.research_question: 土耳其是否存在无就业增长现象？各部门增长对失业率的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 探讨土耳其是否存在"无就业增长"现象，即经济增长是否未能创造足够的就业机会，这对理解土耳其劳动力市场和经济发展具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于无就业增长理论，分析经济增长与就业之间的关系，特别是各部门增长对失业率的不同影响。
AI.method: 使用ARDL（自回归分布滞后）方法分析2000-2022年年度数据，并用FMOLS和CCR方法验证结果，对农业、工业、建筑业和服务业四个部门进行分析。
AI.findings: 所有部门的增长都能减少失业率。短期影响：农业部门GDP占比每增加1单位，失业率下降0.471点；工业部门下降0.680点；建筑业下降0.899点；服务业下降1.383点。长期影响更强：农业下降2.380点；工业下降4.057点；建筑业下降1.761点；服务业下降3.664点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为无就业增长理论提供了土耳其的实证证据，证明在土耳其背景下经济增长确实能创造就业，挑战了无就业增长的普遍假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其政策制定者提供了部门层面的就业创造策略依据，特别是服务业和工业部门对减少失业的显著作用，有助于制定更有针对性的就业政策。

title: Enhancing Flipkart's Reverse Logistics Efficiency with AI Tools
affiliations: ViTrox College, BNM Institute of Technology, Oneworld Hanxin College, Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM), Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM), Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM), Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM), Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM) and Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM) - Department of Management

detail.title: Enhancing Flipkart's Reverse Logistics Efficiency with AI Tools
detail.abstract: Flipkart is a major Indian e-commerce platform, founded in 2007, offering products like electronics, clothing, and home goods. Flipkart has managed to connect India's wide and diverse regions with a vast network of brands and sellers through technology, logistics, and payment systems. This study explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can help improve Flipkart's reverse logistics system, which handles customer returns. The study focused on identifying common problems such as delays, communication errors, and high return costs. A simple survey was conducted among online shoppers to understand their product return experience on Flipkart. The study also used basic data such as the average return time and the reasons for the return. The results show that many problems can be reduced with the use of AI tools such as chatbots, automatic return tracking, and intelligent decision systems. The study shows that even small AI improvements can make the return process faster and easier for customers and companies. This project highlights how technology can make online shopping more efficient and user-friendly. Our findings provide guidance for Flipkart's digital strategy to help increase customer satisfaction and loyalty in India.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了人工智能如何改善Flipkart的逆向物流系统，通过调查发现AI工具如聊天机器人、自动退货跟踪和智能决策系统可以减少退货过程中的延迟、沟通错误和高成本问题。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何帮助改善Flipkart的逆向物流系统，以解决客户退货过程中的问题？
AI.motivation: Flipkart作为印度主要电商平台，其逆向物流系统存在延迟、沟通错误和高退货成本等问题，影响了客户体验和运营效率，需要技术改进来提升服务质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于电子商务逆向物流管理理论和人工智能在供应链中的应用框架，探讨AI技术如何优化退货流程。
AI.method: 采用简单问卷调查收集在线购物者的退货体验数据，结合平均退货时间和退货原因等基础数据分析，评估AI工具的潜在改进效果。
AI.findings: 研究发现AI工具（如聊天机器人、自动退货跟踪和智能决策系统）可以显著减少退货过程中的问题，即使是小的AI改进也能使退货流程更快、更便捷，提升客户和公司的效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 为电子商务逆向物流管理理论提供了AI技术应用的实证支持，扩展了AI在供应链优化中的理论框架，特别是在新兴市场电商环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Flipkart提供了具体的数字化战略指导，帮助提高客户满意度和忠诚度，同时为其他电商平台展示了如何通过AI技术改进逆向物流系统的实践路径。

detail.abstract:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PLEASE CITE THE PUBLISHED VERSION:

Akusta, E. (2025). Measuring and rating socioeconomic disparities among provinces: A case of Türkiye. Journal of Economic Policy Researches / İktisat Politikası Araştırmaları Dergisi, 12(1), 45–67. https://doi.org/10.26650/jepr1472224

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Regional disparities in the economic and social structures of countries have a great impact on their development levels. In geographically, culturally and economically diverse countries like Türkiye, determining the socioeconomic status of the provinces and regional differences is an important step for planning and implementing effective policies. Therefore, this study aims to determine the socioeconomic disparities of the provinces in Türkiye. For this purpose, a socioeconomic development index covering the economic and social dimensions of 81 provinces was constructed. For the index, 16 different indicators representing economic and social factors were used. These indicators were converted into indices using the Min-Max normalization method and Principal Component Analysis. Afterwards, using these indices, the provinces were divided into groups using the K-Means clustering algorithm and the Elbow method. In the last part of the study, the results are presented in a visual format using Scatter Plots, clustering maps and QGIS mapping tools. The results of the study show that 2 of the 81 provinces in Türkiye have very high, 30 high, 25 medium and 24 low socioeconomic indices. Istanbul and Ankara have very high socioeconomic status. In general, the provinces in western Türkiye have a high socioeconomic index, while the provinces in eastern and southeastern Anatolia face serious challenges in terms of socioeconomic indicators.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了土耳其81个省份的社会经济发展指数，使用16个经济和社会指标，通过主成分分析和聚类方法评估各省份的社会经济差异，发现东西部地区存在显著发展差距。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量和评估土耳其各省份之间的社会经济差异？
AI.motivation: 区域经济和社会结构差异对国家发展水平有重要影响，对于土耳其这样地理、文化和经济多样化的国家，确定各省份的社会经济状况和区域差异是制定和实施有效政策的重要步骤。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域发展理论、社会经济指标构建理论、主成分分析理论、聚类分析理论
AI.method: 1. 构建社会经济指数：使用16个经济和社会指标；2. 数据标准化：采用Min-Max归一化方法；3. 降维处理：使用主成分分析；4. 聚类分析：采用K-Means聚类算法和Elbow方法；5. 可视化：使用散点图、聚类地图和QGIS制图工具
AI.findings: 1. 土耳其81个省份中：2个省份社会经济指数非常高，30个高，25个中等，24个低；2. 伊斯坦布尔和安卡拉社会经济地位最高；3. 土耳其西部省份普遍具有较高的社会经济指数；4. 东部和东南部安纳托利亚地区省份在社会经济指标方面面临严重挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了适用于土耳其国情的社会经济指数构建方法；2. 将主成分分析与聚类分析结合用于区域发展评估；3. 为类似多样化国家的区域差异研究提供了方法论参考
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为土耳其政策制定者提供了各省份社会经济状况的详细评估；2. 识别了需要优先发展的区域；3. 为区域发展政策的制定提供了数据支持；4. 可视化工具便于政策沟通和实施

detail.title: Assessment and Prioritization of Renewable Energy Alternatives to Achieve Sustainable Development Goals in Türkiye: Based on Fuzzy AHP Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Energy Studies, volume 9, issue 4, 2024[10.58559/ijes.1494256]

detail.abstract:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PLEASE CITE THE PUBLISHED VERSION:

Akusta, E., & Cergibozan, R. (2024). Assessment and prioritization of renewable energy alternatives to achieve sustainable development goals in Türkiye: Based on fuzzy AHP approach. International Journal of Energy Studies, 9(4), 809–847. https://doi.org/10.58559/ijes.1494256

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


The aim of this study is to prioritize renewable energy sources to achieve sustainable development in Türkiye by using fuzzy AHP method. In our study, we used 30 criteria that affect the investment in renewable energy sources. We also calculated the weights of these criteria in investment decisions. In addition, we analyzed the advantageous renewable energy sources according to each criterion. Thus, it was determined which renewable energy source is advantageous according to which criteria. The results show that the most important main criteria for renewable energy investments in Türkiye are economic, political, technical, environmental and social criteria, respectively. The most appropriate renewable energy sources according to economic, political, technical and social criteria are solar, wind, hydroelectric, biomass and geothermal respectively.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用模糊层次分析法（fuzzy AHP）评估和优先排序土耳其的可再生能源替代方案，以实现可持续发展目标。研究确定了30个影响可再生能源投资的标准，并计算了各标准的权重，分析了不同可再生能源在不同标准下的优势。
AI.research_question: 土耳其为实现可持续发展目标，应如何优先选择和投资可再生能源？哪些可再生能源在不同标准下具有优势？
AI.motivation: 土耳其需要实现可持续发展目标，而可再生能源是实现这些目标的关键。然而，在多种可再生能源选择中，需要系统的方法来确定投资优先级，考虑经济、政治、技术、环境和社会等多方面因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊层次分析法（fuzzy AHP）作为多标准决策分析工具，用于处理不确定性和主观判断。可持续发展理论框架，特别是联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）为背景。
AI.method: 采用模糊层次分析法（fuzzy AHP），确定了30个影响可再生能源投资的标准，计算各标准权重，并评估太阳能、风能、水力、生物质能和地热能等可再生能源在不同标准下的表现。
AI.findings: 土耳其可再生能源投资最重要的五大标准依次为：经济、政治、技术、环境和社会标准。根据经济、政治、技术和社会标准，最合适的可再生能源分别是太阳能、风能、水力、生物质能和地热能。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模糊AHP方法应用于土耳其可再生能源投资决策，扩展了多标准决策理论在能源政策领域的应用。为发展中国家可再生能源投资优先级评估提供了方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其政策制定者和投资者提供了可再生能源投资优先级的具体指导，明确了不同可再生能源在不同标准下的优势，有助于制定更有效的能源政策和投资策略以实现可持续发展目标。

title: The Effect of Social Trust on Economic Growth with Emphasis on the Case of Iran
affiliations: Research Institute of Hawzah and University and

detail.title: The Effect of Social Trust on Economic Growth with Emphasis on the Case of Iran
detail.abstract: Today, most social and economic scientists have accepted the important role of extra-economic factors such as social trust in the process of economic development of societies. According to them, public trust affects economic growth not only by creating conditions for cooperation and coordination between individuals and groups and reducing the costs of production, distribution and exchange in the economic system, but also in many other ways. This article, while examining the ways of influencing social trust on economic development, aims to provide a conceptual framework and a practical definition of social trust and its adaptation to the conditions of growth in today's Iranian society. In this research, the method of applying the model of social trust to the last four decades of Iranian society and several approaches have been used for the model of the mechanism of the effect of social trust on economic growth. The article concludes that "responsibility, efficient management, increasing business transactions, reducing possible risks in transactions, increasing domestic and foreign investment, reducing investment costs, creating welfare states" are among the influential mediating factors. are in the mechanism of social trust and economic growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨社会信任对经济发展的影响机制，提出了社会信任的概念框架和实用定义，并将其应用于伊朗社会过去四十年的发展情况，识别出责任、高效管理、增加商业交易等中介因素。
AI.research_question: 社会信任如何影响经济发展？在伊朗社会背景下，社会信任对经济增长的具体作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 大多数社会经济学家已认识到社会信任等非经济因素在经济发展中的重要作用，但需要更具体的概念框架和实用定义来理解社会信任如何影响经济增长，特别是在伊朗社会背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论、信任与经济发展理论、制度经济学理论，强调社会信任通过促进合作、协调和降低交易成本来影响经济发展。
AI.method: 应用社会信任模型分析伊朗社会过去四十年的发展情况，采用多种方法研究社会信任对经济增长的影响机制模型。
AI.findings: 研究发现责任、高效管理、增加商业交易、降低交易风险、增加国内外投资、降低投资成本、创建福利国家等是影响社会信任与经济增长机制的重要中介因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会信任对经济发展的具体作用机制框架，将抽象的社会信任概念转化为可操作的分析工具，丰富了社会资本理论在经济发展中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗政策制定者提供了具体的中介因素清单，可用于制定促进社会信任和经济增长的政策，如加强责任制度、改善管理效率、降低交易风险等。

title: Factors Affecting the Efficiency of Joint Investment Funds in Iran's Economy

detail.title: Factors Affecting the Efficiency of Joint Investment Funds in Iran's Economy
detail.abstract: Joint investment funds, as one of the most vital non-banking financial intermediaries, are responsible for capital transfer from resource owners (society members) to consumers (manufacturing and service companies and others). In Iran, for the first time, based on the Securities Market Law, approved in 2005, joint investment funds were expected, and stock investment funds entered the capital market from the beginning of 2017. The purpose of this research was to investigate the influencing factors on the returns of stock investment funds through the analysis of the history of these funds' performances in Iran's economy. For this purpose, 136 joint funds active in the capital market were examined. Data analysis has been done with a pooled structure (unbalanced panel) and with a fixed effects regression model using the ordinary least squares (OLS) method. The results of this research confirm the existence of a significant linear relationship between fund returns and variables such as fund life, deviation from the average, ownership of all real investors, and inflation in the previous period, and market index in the previous period. Among these, the life of the fund and inflation has a negative effect on the efficiency of the fund and other variables have a positive effect.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了伊朗股市投资基金回报率的影响因素，通过对136只活跃基金的分析，发现基金寿命、偏离均值、真实投资者所有权、前期通胀和前期市场指数等因素对基金回报有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响伊朗股市投资基金的回报率？
AI.motivation: 作为重要的非银行金融中介，共同投资基金在伊朗资本市场的表现值得研究。自2017年引入股票投资基金以来，需要了解影响其回报的关键因素，为投资者和监管机构提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融中介理论和投资组合理论，研究基金特征（如基金寿命、所有权结构）和市场环境因素（如通胀、市场指数）对基金绩效的影响。
AI.method: 使用不平衡面板数据（pooled structure）和固定效应回归模型，采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）分析136只活跃基金的绩效数据。
AI.findings: 研究发现基金回报与基金寿命、偏离均值、真实投资者所有权、前期通胀和前期市场指数存在显著线性关系。其中基金寿命和通胀对基金效率有负向影响，其他变量有正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了新兴市场（特别是伊朗）投资基金绩效影响因素的理论框架，验证了基金特征和市场环境变量在特定制度背景下的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗投资基金管理者提供绩效管理指导，为投资者提供投资决策参考，为监管机构制定相关政策提供实证依据。

title: Post-COP30: Technology Transfer without Access? What Belém Delivered and What it Didn't for Africa
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Post-COP30: Technology Transfer without Access? What Belém Delivered and What it Didn't for Africa
detail.abstract:
Technology transfer has long occupied a central yet unresolved place in the global climate regime. For developing countries, particularly in Africa, access to climate technologies is not a matter of innovation prestige but of survival, competitiveness, and structural transformation. From renewable energy systems and climate-resilient agriculture to early-warning infrastructure and industrial decarbonization, technology determines whether climate commitments remain aspirational or become operational.

At COP30 in Belém, Brazil, technology transfer returned to the negotiating spotlight, though largely embedded within broader discussions on finance, adaptation, and implementation. While the final negotiated text avoided explicit language on fossil fuels and delivered limited attractive breakthroughs, COP30 nonetheless introduced important institutional shifts. These included the launch of the Belém Technology Implementation Programme (TIP), the 15-year renewal of the Climate Technology Centre and Network (CTCN) through 2041, and stronger political signaling around linking technology with finance and just transition pathways.

Yet for Africa, the critical question remains unchanged: do these developments meaningfully improve access to climate technologies, or do they risk reinforcing existing asymmetries between ambition and delivery?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨COP30气候谈判中技术转移机制对非洲国家获取气候技术的影响，分析新制度安排是否真正改善技术获取或强化现有不对称性。
AI.research_question: COP30气候谈判中的技术转移机制（如贝伦技术实施计划、CTCN续期）是否真正改善了非洲国家获取气候技术的能力，还是强化了现有技术获取的不对称性？
AI.motivation: 技术转移在全球气候治理中占据核心但未解决的地位，对非洲发展中国家而言，获取气候技术关乎生存、竞争力和结构转型，而非仅仅是创新声望问题。COP30谈判中技术转移重新成为焦点，但需要评估这些新制度安排的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球气候治理理论、技术转移理论、南北技术不对称理论、制度变迁理论、可持续发展转型理论
AI.method: 政策文本分析（COP30谈判文件、贝伦技术实施计划、CTCN续期文件）、制度分析、比较分析（谈判承诺与实际实施差距）、案例研究（非洲国家技术获取现状）
AI.findings: COP30在技术转移方面引入了重要制度变化：1）启动贝伦技术实施计划（TIP）；2）将气候技术中心与网络（CTCN）续期15年至2041年；3）加强技术与融资、公正转型路径的政治信号。但这些进展仍存在局限性：谈判文本避免明确提及化石燃料，突破有限，且技术转移仍嵌入更广泛的融资、适应和实施讨论中。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化对全球气候治理中技术转移机制演变的理解；2）揭示制度变迁与技术获取不对称性之间的张力；3）为南北技术转移理论提供实证支持；4）拓展气候正义与技术公正转型的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为非洲国家参与气候谈判提供策略建议；2）帮助政策制定者评估技术转移机制的实际效果；3）为国际组织设计更有效的技术转移方案提供参考；4）促进气候技术与融资、公正转型的更好整合。
