affiliations: Banco de España, European Central Bank (ECB), Bank of Portugal, , Central Bank of Malta, Central Bank of Ireland, Latvijas Banka, Banque de France, National Bank of Belgium, Bank of Italy, Central Bank of Malta, Banco de España, Banco de España, Ifo Institute, Latvijas Banka, Bank of Greece, Banque Centrale du Luxembourg, , , , De Nederlandsche Bank, VU University Amsterdam, Central Bank of Ireland, Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB), National Bank of Slovakia, , Banco de España, Bank of Slovenia, Banque de France, Banka Slovenije, Bank of Lithuania, Bank of Greece - Economic Research Department and

detail.title: Fiscal Drag in Theory and Practice: A European Perspective

publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive characterization of “fiscal drag”—the increase in tax revenue that occurs when nominal tax bases grow but nominal parameters of progressive tax legislation are not updated accordingly—across 21 European countries using a microsimu-lation approach. First, we estimate tax-to-base elasticities, showing that the progressivity built in each country’s personal income tax system induces elasticities around 1.7–2 for many countries, indicating a potential for large fiscal drag effects. We unpack these elasticities to show stark heterogeneity in their underlying mechanisms (tax brackets or tax deductions and credits), across income sources (labor, capital, self-employment, public benefits), and across the individual income distribution. Second, we extend the analysis beyond these elastici-ties to study fiscal drag in practice between 2019 and 2023, incorporating observed income growth and legislative changes. We quantify the actual impact of fiscal drag and the extent to which government policies have offset it, either through indexation or other reforms. Our results provide new insights into the fiscal and distributional effects of fiscal drag in Europe, as well as useful statistics for modeling public finances.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用微观模拟方法分析了21个欧洲国家的"财政拖累"现象，即名义税基增长但累进税法的名义参数未相应调整导致的税收增加。研究发现个人所得税系统的累进性导致许多国家的税收弹性约为1.7-2，显示出较大的财政拖累潜力。研究还量化了2019-2023年间财政拖累的实际影响以及政府政策如何通过指数化或其他改革抵消这种影响。
AI.research_question: 欧洲各国个人所得税系统中的财政拖累现象如何影响税收收入和收入分配？政府政策在多大程度上抵消了财政拖累效应？
AI.motivation: 财政拖累是累进税制中一个重要的财政现象，但缺乏对欧洲各国系统性、比较性的实证研究。理解财政拖累的机制、程度和政府应对措施对公共财政建模和政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于累进税制理论和财政拖累概念，分析名义税基增长与税收参数固定性之间的不匹配导致的自动税收增加机制。
AI.method: 采用微观模拟方法，分析21个欧洲国家的个人所得税系统，估计税收对税基的弹性，并分解弹性来源（税率档次、税收减免和抵免），按收入来源（劳动、资本、自雇、公共福利）和收入分布进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 许多欧洲国家的税收弹性约为1.7-2，表明财政拖累潜力大；2) 弹性机制存在显著异质性，不同国家、收入来源和收入分布群体间差异明显；3) 2019-2023年间，政府通过指数化和其他改革部分抵消了财政拖累效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了欧洲各国财政拖累现象的系统性比较分析，深化了对累进税制自动稳定器功能的理解，为税收弹性理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化财政拖累影响和抵消政策效果的工具，有助于改进公共财政建模和税收政策设计，促进更公平的收入分配。

title: How Do Flash Loans Affect Market Liquidity?

detail.title: How Do Flash Loans Affect Market Liquidity?
detail.abstract: Flash loans are a DeFi primitive that allow users to borrow large amounts of capital without collateral, provided the loan is borrowed and repaid within a single atomic transaction. We ask how this form of on-demand, uncollateralized funding affects market liquidity and execution quality in automated market makers. Exploiting the token-level rollout of flash-loan eligibility on Aave as a natural experiment, we show that flash-loan introduction leads to a pronounced and persistent increase in Uniswap V1 liquidity: executable depth, total value locked, and trading activity rise relative to matched control pools, while slippage and volatility do not deteriorate in a sustained way. Using transaction-level classifications and high-frequency panel regressions, we further show that flash-loan intensity is positively associated with subsequent depth and TVL, with effects concentrated in large debt-restructuring and arbitrage loans. Overall, our evidence suggests that flash loans operate primarily as a liquidity-enhancing funding technology that deepens markets without worsening short-run execution quality, while reallocating risk toward passive liquidity providers.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了闪电贷（一种无需抵押、单笔原子交易内借还的DeFi工具）对自动化做市商市场流动性和执行质量的影响。利用Aave平台上闪电贷资格按代币逐步推出的自然实验，研究发现闪电贷引入显著提升了Uniswap V1的流动性（可执行深度、总锁定价值和交易活动增加），而滑点和波动率并未持续恶化。闪电贷强度与后续深度和TVL正相关，效果主要体现在大规模债务重组和套利贷款上。
AI.research_question: 闪电贷这种按需、无抵押的融资形式如何影响自动化做市商的市场流动性和执行质量？
AI.motivation: 闪电贷是DeFi领域的重要创新，允许用户在单笔原子交易内无抵押借入大量资金，但其对市场流动性和执行质量的实际影响尚不明确，需要实证研究来理解这种新型融资工具的市场效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论、流动性供给理论，以及DeFi和闪电贷的特定机制理论，研究闪电贷作为融资技术如何影响市场深度、交易活动和执行质量。
AI.method: 1. 利用Aave平台上闪电贷资格按代币逐步推出的自然实验设计；2. 使用匹配控制池进行对比分析；3. 交易级分类和高频面板回归分析；4. 衡量流动性指标（可执行深度、总锁定价值、交易活动）和执行质量指标（滑点、波动率）。
AI.findings: 1. 闪电贷引入导致Uniswap V1流动性显著且持续增加：可执行深度、总锁定价值和交易活动相对于匹配控制池上升；2. 滑点和波动率并未持续恶化；3. 闪电贷强度与后续深度和TVL正相关，效果主要集中在大规模债务重组和套利贷款上。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地实证检验了闪电贷对DeFi市场流动性的影响；2. 揭示了闪电贷作为流动性增强融资技术的理论机制；3. 拓展了市场微观结构理论在DeFi环境下的应用；4. 为理解无抵押融资工具的市场效应提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为DeFi协议设计者提供了关于闪电贷市场效应的实证证据；2. 帮助流动性提供者理解风险重新分配机制；3. 为监管机构理解闪电贷的实际影响提供参考；4. 为交易者和投资者提供关于市场流动性动态的洞察。

title: LCR Optimization by Banks: Evidence from Changes in Liquidity Requirements in Switzerland
affiliations: Swiss National Bank and Swiss National Bank (SNB)

detail.title: LCR Optimization by Banks: Evidence from Changes in Liquidity Requirements in Switzerland

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss National Bank Working Paper No. 18/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss National Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this paper, we analyze the effects of the introduction of the liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) on banks' funding behavior. We use changes in regulatory liquidity requirements in Switzerland as a natural experiment. Using data for the period before and after the LCR was applied for all banks in Switzerland, our dataset allows us to analyze how the introduction of the LCR affects the banks' funding structure. Our results show that the LCR had its intended effects as banks reduced their exposure to short-term funding. At the same time, we find evidence for optimization of the LCR by banks. Banks optimize their LCR by extending the maturities of liabilities slightly over 30 days, which leads to an improvement in the LCR by 10 percentage points on average. Our results imply that it makes sense to complement the 30-day LCR with longer-term liquidity requirements to reduce cliff risks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了流动性覆盖率（LCR）引入对银行融资行为的影响，使用瑞士监管变化作为自然实验。研究发现LCR实现了预期效果，银行减少了短期融资敞口，但同时也存在优化行为——银行将负债期限略微延长至30天以上，平均提升LCR 10个百分点，建议补充长期流动性要求以降低悬崖风险。
AI.research_question: 流动性覆盖率（LCR）的引入如何影响银行的融资行为？
AI.motivation: 了解银行监管政策（特别是流动性要求）对银行融资结构的影响，评估LCR政策的实际效果和银行的应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行监管理论、流动性风险管理理论和银行行为理论，分析监管政策变化对银行融资决策的影响。
AI.method: 使用瑞士LCR对所有银行实施前后的数据，以监管变化作为自然实验，采用前后对比分析方法研究银行融资结构变化。
AI.findings: 1. LCR实现了预期效果，银行减少了短期融资敞口；2. 银行存在LCR优化行为，将负债期限略微延长至30天以上；3. 这种优化使LCR平均提升10个百分点；4. 需要补充长期流动性要求以降低悬崖风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了监管政策对银行行为影响的实证证据；2. 揭示了银行对监管要求的策略性应对行为；3. 丰富了流动性监管有效性的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构评估LCR政策效果提供依据；2. 建议补充长期流动性要求以完善监管框架；3. 帮助银行理解监管环境下的最优融资策略。

title: Attitudes of Foreign Employees Towards AI at Work in Turkish Organizations

detail.title: Attitudes of Foreign Employees Towards AI at Work in Turkish Organizations
detail.abstract: The speed at which artificial intelligence (AI) is being incorporated in the work sphere has fundamentally changed the face of organizational activities across the globe. Nevertheless, the acceptance and employee perception of AI is complicated, especially concerning foreign employees who might be working in a culturally diverse environment like Türkiye. This thesis investigates the attitudes of foreign employees toward AI at work in Turkish organizations, employing validated scales adapted from Park et al. (2024) and focusing on core constructs: AI-use anxiety, job insecurity, perceived quality of AI and personal utility of AI. The data was gathered by using a structured survey of a heterogeneous sample of legally working foreign professional across the industry in Türkiye. Using an integrated theoretical approach that incorporates the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT), Social Cognitive Theory (SCT), and Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), this thesis also examines the attitudes of foreign workers toward AI adoption in Turkish organizations. Eight hypotheses investigating the direct and intermediary impacts of psychological and demographic aspects on AI acceptance were developed using these frameworks as a guide. Through rigorous statistical analysis, including exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses, as well as mediation model using HAYES process, the study reveals that perceived quality of AI is a significant positive predictor of personal Utility of AI for foreigners at their work place. Furthermore, AI-use anxiety and perceived job insecurity do not significantly impact personal utility of AI at work. The findings demonstrate the critical role of perceived AI quality in shaping acceptance of AI at workplace in Türkiye, highlight the mediating effect of personal utility. The study also explores age and other demographic factors such as gender and frequency of AI use, providing nuanced insights into the experiences of foreign employees. The results indicate directions for further study in cross-cultural settings and offer organizations practical suggestions for encouraging the inclusive and encouraging adoption of AI technologies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在土耳其工作的外籍员工对工作场所人工智能的态度，发现感知AI质量是影响AI接受度的关键因素，而AI使用焦虑和工作不安全感对个人效用无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 在土耳其工作的外籍员工对工作场所人工智能的态度如何？哪些心理和人口因素影响他们对AI的接受度？
AI.motivation: AI在全球工作场所快速普及，但员工对AI的接受度复杂，特别是在文化多元环境中的外籍员工。土耳其作为文化多元的工作环境，研究外籍员工对AI的态度具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合理论框架：技术接受与使用统一理论(UTAUT)、社会认知理论(SCT)、技术接受模型(TAM)。
AI.method: 采用结构化问卷调查土耳其各行业合法工作的外籍专业人士异质样本。使用探索性和验证性因子分析，以及HAYES过程的调解模型进行严格统计分析。
AI.findings: 1. 感知AI质量是外籍员工工作场所AI个人效用的显著正向预测因子；2. AI使用焦虑和感知工作不安全感对个人效用无显著影响；3. 个人效用在感知AI质量与AI接受度之间起中介作用；4. 年龄、性别和AI使用频率等人口因素提供细微洞察。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合UTAUT、SCT和TAM理论框架研究跨文化AI接受度；2. 验证感知AI质量在跨文化环境中的核心作用；3. 挑战AI焦虑和工作不安全感对AI效用的传统假设；4. 为跨文化AI接受研究提供理论扩展。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为土耳其组织提供促进AI包容性采纳的实践建议；2. 强调提升AI质量感知的重要性；3. 帮助组织设计针对外籍员工的AI培训和支持策略；4. 为跨文化工作环境的AI实施提供指导。

title: Analytical Framework for Assessing the Res Judicata Effects of International Arbitral Awards
affiliations: Senior Judicial Magistrate at Bangladesh Judicial Service

detail.title: Analytical Framework for Assessing the Res Judicata Effects of International Arbitral Awards
detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive analytical framework for the doctrine of res judicata within the decentralized system of international arbitration. Grounded as a general principle of law under Article 38(1)(c) of the ICJ Statute, the doctrine balances the public interest in legal finality with the private need to protect parties from the vexation of repetitious suits.

AI.tldr: 本文为国际仲裁中的既判力原则提供了一个全面的分析框架，平衡法律终局性的公共利益与保护当事人免受重复诉讼困扰的私人需求。
AI.research_question: 在国际仲裁的分散化体系中，既判力原则应如何理解和应用？
AI.motivation: 国际仲裁体系缺乏中央权威，导致既判力原则的应用存在不一致性和不确定性，需要建立统一的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《国际法院规约》第38(1)(c)条作为一般法律原则的既判力理论，平衡法律终局性公共利益与当事人私人保护需求。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，结合国际仲裁实践和比较法研究。
AI.findings: 既判力原则在国际仲裁中具有特殊重要性，需要在分散化体系中建立统一的应用标准，平衡终局性与公平性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为国际仲裁中的既判力原则提供了系统的理论框架，明确了其在分散化体系中的适用标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为仲裁员、律师和当事人提供了既判力原则在国际仲裁中的具体应用指南，增强了仲裁裁决的可预测性和一致性。

title: Pandemic Risk Perception in Family-Owned SMEs: Environmental Determinants and Nonparametric Evidence from Poland
affiliations: , Wroclaw University of Science and Technology, Jan Długosz University and Wrocław University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Pandemic Risk Perception in Family-Owned SMEs: Environmental Determinants and Nonparametric Evidence from Poland
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic caused unprecedented disruptions in the operations of SMEs, with family businesses proving particularly vulnerable due to limited resources and the lack of separation between ownership and management functions. Previous research on risk perception in this segment is scarce and fragmented, creating a significant research gap in the context of extreme crises. The aim of this article was to examine how selected environmental factors influence pandemic risk perception in family-owned SMEs. A purposive sample of 100 business owners from Lower Silesia (2020) was surveyed using a Pandemic Risk Perception Index (α = 0.881), and its relationships with perceived changes in VAT, legal regulations, government policy stability, as well as social security contributions, rental costs, and fuel prices were analyzed. Due to the distribution of variables, Spearman's rank correlation and the Kruskal-Wallis test were applied. The index correlated significantly and positively with all environmental factors (strongest associations: social security contributions ρ = 0.849, rental costs ρ = 0.828, fuel prices ρ = 0.790; all p < 0.001). Significant differences in risk perception were found between company size classes (p = 0.044) and location types (p = 0.009), while no differences were observed with respect to legal form, age, or business status. The findings indicate that risk perception in family SMEs is particularly linked to cost burdens and the regulatory context, and its level varies by firm size and location. This article contributes by developing a risk perception index and identifying key determinants under pandemic crisis conditions. Limitations include purposive sampling and the absence of post-hoc analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了家族中小企业在COVID-19疫情期间的风险感知如何受环境因素影响，发现社保缴纳、租金成本和燃料价格等成本负担与风险感知呈强正相关，且风险感知水平因企业规模和所在地类型而异。
AI.research_question: 在极端危机背景下，哪些环境因素会影响家族中小企业的疫情风险感知？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情对中小企业运营造成前所未有的破坏，家族企业因资源有限且所有权与管理职能未分离而特别脆弱。现有关于该细分市场风险感知的研究稀缺且碎片化，在极端危机背景下存在显著研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险感知理论，环境因素对企业风险感知的影响框架，家族企业脆弱性理论。
AI.method: 采用目的性抽样对下西里西亚地区100名企业主进行问卷调查，使用疫情风险感知指数（α=0.881），分析其与增值税变化、法律法规、政府政策稳定性、社保缴纳、租金成本和燃料价格等环境因素的关系。由于变量分布，应用斯皮尔曼等级相关和克鲁斯卡尔-沃利斯检验。
AI.findings: 风险感知指数与所有环境因素均呈显著正相关（最强关联：社保缴纳ρ=0.849，租金成本ρ=0.828，燃料价格ρ=0.790；所有p<0.001）。风险感知在企业规模类别（p=0.044）和所在地类型（p=0.009）之间存在显著差异，但在法律形式、企业年龄或经营状况方面无差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了疫情风险感知指数，在极端危机背景下识别了家族中小企业风险感知的关键决定因素，填补了该领域研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供见解：减轻成本负担（特别是社保、租金、燃料）和稳定监管环境可降低家族企业的风险感知。企业规模和所在地类型差异表明需要针对性的支持措施。

title: Cobots: The Possibilities of Artificial Intelligence in the Safe Interaction of Humans and Robots in Production Processes
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Cobots: The Possibilities of Artificial Intelligence in the Safe Interaction of Humans and Robots in Production Processes
detail.abstract: The potential of increasing the efficiency of automation in industrial production based on the use of collaborative robots (cobots), which account for about 10% of industrial robot installations in the world and are designed to work together with humans in the same workspace, is being considered. The cobot's distinctive characteristics in comparison with traditional industrial robots, its applicability in production operations, advantages and disadvantages are presented. The theses on the impact of gesture and voice recognition technologies, integration with machine vision, adaptation of learning and predictive safety on the improvement of the functionality and design of cobots are presented. The conclusion is made about the production and investment attractiveness of cobots for industrial small and medium enterprises, taking into account the further development of artificial intelligence technologies to ensure safe collaboration between robots and humans.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了协作机器人在工业生产中的效率提升潜力，分析了其与传统工业机器人的区别、应用场景、优缺点，并讨论了手势语音识别、机器视觉集成、学习适应和预测性安全等技术对协作机器人功能改进的影响，最后评估了协作机器人对中小企业的投资吸引力。
AI.research_question: 协作机器人如何提高工业自动化效率？其技术发展（如手势语音识别、机器视觉集成、学习适应和预测性安全）如何影响其功能和设计？协作机器人对工业中小企业的生产和投资吸引力如何？
AI.motivation: 协作机器人仅占全球工业机器人安装量的10%，但具有与人类在同一工作空间协同工作的独特能力，有潜力显著提高工业自动化效率。随着人工智能技术的发展，协作机器人的安全性和功能性不断提升，对中小企业尤其具有吸引力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人机协作理论、工业自动化理论、技术采纳理论，分析协作机器人的技术特性和应用价值，结合人工智能技术发展框架评估其未来演进路径。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和理论分析方法，对比协作机器人与传统工业机器人的特征差异，分析手势语音识别、机器视觉集成、学习适应和预测性安全等关键技术对协作机器人功能的影响，评估其对中小企业的投资价值。
AI.findings: 1. 协作机器人具有与传统工业机器人不同的安全协作特性；2. 手势语音识别、机器视觉等技术能显著提升协作机器人功能；3. 学习适应和预测性安全技术能改善人机协作安全性；4. 协作机器人对中小企业具有较高的生产和投资吸引力，特别是在人工智能技术支持下。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了协作机器人技术发展对工业自动化效率影响的理论框架；2. 提出了人机协作安全性与功能性平衡的理论模型；3. 发展了中小企业技术采纳决策的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为工业企业选择协作机器人提供决策参考；2. 为协作机器人技术研发指明方向（手势语音识别、机器视觉集成等）；3. 为中小企业评估协作机器人投资价值提供实用指南；4. 为制定人机协作安全标准提供实践建议。

title: When Rules Don't Bend: A Fiscal Geometry Analysis of Credential-Based Education Entry Gates

detail.title: When Rules Don't Bend: A Fiscal Geometry Analysis of Credential-Based Education Entry Gates

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on document analysis and institutional structures. It does not involve human participants, personal data, or interventions and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This working paper applies Fiscal Geometry as a coordinate-based analytical framework to examine credential-based education entry gates across regulated professions. Rather than treating licensing as a profession-specific access debate, the paper models credentialing as a rulegoverned education regime composed of recurring administrative–fiscal events (eligibility checks, examinations, supervised experience validation, documentation review, and fee/timeline constraints). These events are represented as positions and movements in a two-axis space: the X-axis captures cross-jurisdictional fiscal shift in pre-tax public capital as candidates traverse institutional recognition, classification, and pathway interfaces; the Y-axis captures intergenerational post-tax capacity, reflecting household-level carrying capacity for delay, repetition, and cumulative compliance costs over extended timelines. Using CPA licensing as the main analytical stream and introducing STEP, engineering (PEO), and medical credential pathways in Ontario as comparative validation cases, the paper shows how standardized rules generate observable structural properties—horizontal rigidity, vertical amplification, checkpoint clustering, and bottleneck formation—without relying on normative evaluation. A measurement layer is then specified through a family of indices (ITI, gITI, IDI, ETI, EPTI) to render tension concentration and design–realization misalignment comparable across credential systems. The contribution is methodological: it offers a replicable grammar for mapping credential education systems as measurable institutional structures, supporting comparative analysis across jurisdictions and professions while remaining non-prescriptive.

AI.tldr: 本文应用财政几何学作为坐标分析框架，研究受监管职业的基于证书的教育准入机制。将证书制度建模为由重复行政-财政事件组成的规则治理教育体系，通过二维空间分析其结构特性，并提出可比较的测量指标。
AI.research_question: 如何系统分析和比较不同职业证书教育体系的结构特性，而不依赖规范性评价？
AI.motivation: 传统上职业许可被视为特定职业的准入辩论，缺乏系统性的跨职业比较框架。需要一种非规范性的方法来分析证书教育体系作为可测量的制度结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政几何学（Fiscal Geometry）作为坐标分析框架，将证书制度视为由重复行政-财政事件组成的规则治理教育体系。
AI.method: 使用二维空间分析：X轴捕捉跨辖区财政转移（税前公共资本），Y轴捕捉代际税后能力（家庭承受能力）。以CPA许可为主要分析案例，引入STEP、工程（PEO）和医疗证书路径作为比较验证案例。
AI.findings: 标准化规则产生可观察的结构特性：水平刚性、垂直放大、检查点聚集和瓶颈形成。开发了ITI、gITI、IDI、ETI、EPTI等指标来测量紧张集中度和设计-实现偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 方法论贡献：提供可复制的语法来将证书教育体系映射为可测量的制度结构，支持跨辖区和跨职业的比较分析，同时保持非规范性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供系统分析工具，可以比较不同职业证书体系的结构特性，识别瓶颈和改进机会，而不预设规范性立场。

title: Silent Regime Change: Intelligence-Led Displacement and the Collapse of the Syrian Regime
affiliations: Lebanese University and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Silent Regime Change: Intelligence-Led Displacement and the Collapse of the Syrian Regime
detail.abstract: This study examines the December 2024 collapse of the Syrian regime as a case of intelligence-led displacement-regime change achieved through covert paralysis of command structures rather than military defeat. Within eleven days, a government that survived thirteen years of civil war ceased functioning without decisive battle, visible political rupture, or leadership defiance. Using intelligence studies methodology-pattern recognition, tradecraft signature analysis, and testimonial triangulation-we demonstrate that Syria's collapse exhibits signatures of coordinated intelligence operations rather than organic failure. We identify Russia's GRU (Main Intelligence Directorate) as the probable architect (75-85% confidence), leveraging nine years of embedded access to execute synchronized paralysis across five domains: command communications, airspace operations, elite security, leadership extraction, and information environment. The operation succeeded through a tacit "alliance of silence" among major powers (Russia, Iran, Turkey, United States), each securing strategic benefits while avoiding public accountability. This research contributes three theoretical innovations: (1) conceptualizing "silent regime change" as distinct from conventional regime change modalities; (2) revealing the "patron-asexecutor paradox" whereby protection mechanisms become termination pathways; (3) documenting multilateral deconfliction through operational signals rather than diplomatic coordination. We provide vulnerability assessment frameworks for externally dependent regimes and demonstrate how intelligence services function as autonomous geopolitical actors capable of engineering state-level transformation.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2024年12月叙利亚政权崩溃的案例，认为这是通过情报主导的"无声政权更迭"实现的，而非军事击败。俄罗斯GRU利用九年嵌入式访问，同步瘫痪了五个关键领域，而大国间的"沉默联盟"则避免了公开问责。
AI.research_question: 叙利亚政权如何在2024年12月突然崩溃？这是否代表了情报主导的"无声政权更迭"新模式？
AI.motivation: 叙利亚政权在经历了13年内战后突然在11天内崩溃，没有决定性战役、可见的政治破裂或领导层反抗，这种异常现象需要新的解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 情报研究框架：模式识别、技术特征分析、证词三角验证
2. 无声政权更迭理论
3. 保护者-执行者悖论
4. 多边行动协调信号理论
AI.method: 采用情报研究方法论：模式识别、技术特征分析、证词三角验证，分析叙利亚崩溃事件的特征模式。
AI.findings:
1. 叙利亚崩溃显示出协调情报行动的特征，而非有机失败
2. 俄罗斯GRU是可能的策划者（75-85%置信度）
3. 行动通过五个领域的同步瘫痪实现：指挥通信、空域操作、精英安全、领导层撤离、信息环境
4. 大国间形成"沉默联盟"，各自获得战略利益同时避免公开问责
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 概念化"无声政权更迭"作为与传统政权更迭模式不同的新类型
2. 揭示"保护者-执行者悖论"：保护机制可能成为终结途径
3. 记录通过行动信号而非外交协调的多边冲突避免机制
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为外部依赖型政权提供脆弱性评估框架
2. 展示情报机构如何作为自主的地缘政治行为体，能够策划国家层面的变革

title: The Invisible Hand of Science: How Strategic Competition Drives Positive-Sum Innovation

detail.title: The Invisible Hand of Science: How Strategic Competition Drives Positive-Sum Innovation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that the long-run development of mathematics, science, and technology is inseparable from strategic competition among states. When innovation confers differential survival or geopolitical advantage, rivalry imposes extreme constraints of time, risk, and performance that force the discovery of general solutions. These solutions, once created, diffuse beyond their original military context and generate positive-sum spillovers for civilian life. Historical evidence from antiquity through the Cold War illustrates this mechanism. Advances in computation, cryptography, nuclear physics, medicine, and Earth system science were pursued primarily for military or state purposes under existential pressure, yet later became foundations of civilian prosperity, from secure communications and weather prediction to medical imaging and public health. The pattern parallels Adam Smith’s “invisible hand”: self-interested pursuit of security and power unintentionally produces broad social benefits. The paper formalizes this dynamic as the Iron Law of Dual Use: any tool powerful enough to matter in peace will eventually matter in war, and any tool developed for war will diffuse into civilian life. The analysis concludes by drawing policy implications for structuring public research institutions and delineating the appropriate division of labor between government and private capital in innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文认为数学、科学与技术的长期发展离不开国家间的战略竞争。当创新带来生存或地缘政治优势时，竞争会施加时间、风险和性能的极端约束，迫使发现通用解决方案。这些解决方案一旦创造出来，就会超越其原始军事背景扩散，为民用生活产生正和溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 国家间的战略竞争如何驱动数学、科学和技术的长期发展？军事创新如何转化为民用领域的广泛社会效益？
AI.motivation: 理解创新驱动力的本质，特别是军事竞争在推动技术进步中的核心作用，以及这种机制如何产生超越军事领域的广泛社会效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: "双重用途铁律"：任何在和平时期足够重要的工具最终都会在战争中变得重要，任何为战争开发的工具都会扩散到民用生活中。借鉴亚当·斯密的"看不见的手"理论，将自利的安全和权力追求产生的意外社会效益概念化。
AI.method: 历史案例分析法，从古代到冷战时期的历史证据，涵盖计算、密码学、核物理、医学和地球系统科学等领域，展示军事需求驱动创新的模式。
AI.findings: 战略竞争通过施加极端的时间、风险和性能约束，迫使发现通用解决方案。这些解决方案后来扩散到民用领域，产生正和溢出效应，成为民用繁荣的基础，如安全通信、天气预报、医学成像和公共卫生等。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"双重用途铁律"理论框架，将军事竞争驱动的创新机制概念化。将亚当·斯密的"看不见的手"理论扩展到国家安全领域，解释自利的安全追求如何产生广泛的社会效益。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共研究机构的结构设计提供政策启示，界定政府和私人资本在创新中的适当分工。帮助决策者理解军事研发投资的长期社会回报，优化创新政策。

title: When the Patent Quid Pro Quo is Distorted: Protection-Disclosure Imbalance and Follow-on Innovation
affiliations: Copenhagen Business School - Department of Economics

detail.title: When the Patent Quid Pro Quo is Distorted: Protection-Disclosure Imbalance and Follow-on Innovation
detail.abstract: How does a distortion of the patent quid pro quo, which grants inventors a temporary monopoly right in exchange for full and clear disclosure of their invention, influence follow-on innovation? We study this using text data from US patent application-grant pairs. To proxy the severity of distortions, we use the magnitude of examiner-induced corrections to application scope-disclosure imbalances, measured as changes in textual characteristics between application and grant. Patent prosecution data allow us to exploit the quasi-random assignment of applications to examiners as a source of variation in detecting scope-disclosure imbalances via Section 112 rejections. Instrumental variable estimates show that granted patents whose underlying applications required larger examiner-induced corrections receive fewer citations. This pattern is consistent with those applications being badly drafted, overly broad, or unclear. It reflects unintentional or strategic distortions of the quid pro quo at the application stage that are associated with fewer forward citations.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国专利申请-授权文本数据，通过审查员对申请范围-披露不平衡的修正程度来衡量专利交换条件扭曲的严重性。研究发现，需要更大审查员修正的授权专利获得更少后续引用，表明这些申请存在起草不良、范围过宽或不清晰的问题，反映了申请阶段对专利交换条件的无意或策略性扭曲会抑制后续创新。
AI.research_question: 专利交换条件的扭曲（即授予发明人临时垄断权以换取完整清晰披露）如何影响后续创新？
AI.motivation: 专利制度的核心是交换条件：发明人获得临时垄断权，作为交换必须完整清晰地披露发明。然而，申请阶段可能存在扭曲这种交换条件的行为（如起草不良、范围过宽或不清晰披露），这些扭曲如何影响后续创新尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利交换条件理论（quid pro quo theory）：专利制度通过授予临时垄断权来激励创新，同时要求充分披露以促进知识传播和后续创新。当申请存在范围-披露不平衡时，会扭曲这一交换条件。
AI.method: 使用美国专利申请-授权对的文本数据。以审查员对申请范围-披露不平衡的修正程度（申请文本与授权文本之间的变化）作为扭曲严重性的代理变量。利用专利申请随机分配给审查员的准自然实验，通过第112条驳回作为工具变量来识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 工具变量估计显示，需要更大审查员修正的授权专利获得更少的后续引用。这表明这些申请存在起草不良、范围过宽或不清晰的问题，反映了申请阶段对专利交换条件的无意或策略性扭曲会抑制后续创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了专利交换条件扭曲对后续创新影响的实证证据；2）开发了基于文本分析的扭曲测量方法；3）揭示了申请质量（起草、范围、清晰度）对创新生态系统的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为专利审查员提供了识别问题申请的工具；2）帮助申请人理解高质量申请的重要性；3）为政策制定者提供了改进专利制度的依据；4）有助于提高专利系统的效率和创新促进作用。

reference: Fisher College of Business Working Paper No. 2025-03-024; Charles A. Dice Working Paper No. 2025-24
title: Acquiring Supplier Networks: Domestic Mergers for International Supply Chain Resilience
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Chinese University of Hong Kong, ABFER, CEPR, and ECGI, Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Finance and Stevens Institute of Technology - School of Business

detail.title: Acquiring Supplier Networks: Domestic Mergers for International Supply Chain Resilience

publicationDetails.detailsText: Fisher College of Business Working Paper No. 2025-03-024
publicationDetails.journalName: Ohio State University, Fisher College of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Long-standing international supplier relationships represent valuable and hard-to-replicate intangible assets that mitigate the search and contracting frictions inherent in global value chains. We propose and show that domestic mergers and acquisitions (M&A) serve as a key strategic vehicle for acquiring these established supplier networks, providing a novel source of merger synergy. Using detailed transaction-level shipment data from 2007–2020, we find that post-merger, acquirers systematically adopt the target’s supplier relationships, with a pronounced preference for those that are long-standing. This adoption occurs for both inputs the acquirer already sources (enhancing resilience) and new inputs (facilitating expansion). Consistent with this type of synergy, the likelihood of a merger increases with the similarity of the firms’ imported input portfolios, especially during periods of heightened supply-chain risk, when the value of a target's vetted network is highest. Furthermore, these mergers generate competitive advantages through foreclosure-like effects on target rivals when their supply chains overlap with the acquirer’s, leading to improved valuations and sales growth for target firms. Overall, we show that a primary synergy in many M&As is the acquisition of “relational capital” embedded in the target’s supply chain.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现国内并购是获取目标公司长期国际供应商关系网络的重要战略手段，这些关系网络作为难以复制的无形资产，能够减少全球价值链中的搜索和合同摩擦，创造并购协同效应。
AI.research_question: 国内并购如何通过获取目标公司的长期国际供应商关系网络创造协同效应？
AI.motivation: 长期国际供应商关系是难以复制的无形资产，能够缓解全球价值链中的搜索和合同摩擦。现有研究尚未充分探讨并购如何通过获取这些关系网络创造价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系资本理论、资源基础观、交易成本经济学、并购协同效应理论
AI.method: 使用2007-2020年交易层面的货运数据，分析并购后收购方如何采用目标公司的供应商关系，特别关注长期关系
AI.findings:
1. 并购后收购方系统性地采用目标公司的供应商关系，尤其偏好长期关系
2. 这种采用既包括已有投入品（增强韧性）也包括新投入品（促进扩张）
3. 并购可能性随企业进口投入组合相似性增加，在供应链风险高时尤其明显
4. 当目标竞争对手的供应链与收购方重叠时，会产生类似排他效应的竞争优势
5. 目标公司获得估值提升和销售增长
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出并购协同效应的新来源：获取目标公司的"关系资本"
2. 扩展了关系资本理论在并购领域的应用
3. 深化了对全球价值链中无形资产转移机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业并购决策提供新视角：关注目标公司的供应商关系网络价值
2. 在供应链风险高时，并购具有相似进口组合的公司可能创造更大价值
3. 帮助企业通过并购获取难以复制的国际供应商关系，建立竞争优势

title: An Outsider's View of Mediation Law Reform in Africa
affiliations: UC Law, San Francisco

detail.title: An Outsider's View of Mediation Law Reform in Africa
detail.abstract: This paper offers a summary of the state of mediation legislation on the African Continent as of 2019 and offers four questions of further consideration for reformers working in the Continent: 1) How important is it for a state to adopt national mediation legislation if it wishes to se an appreciable uptick in mediation use? 2) If national legislation is the chosen route, how important is it for a state to be recognized as a Model Mediation Law jurisdiction? 3) Is there a danger of mediation regulation being fashioned too much in arbitration's image; 4) Is there the opposite danger of mediation law and arbitration law being placed in separate silos and not being considered holistically?

AI.tldr: 本文总结了2019年非洲大陆调解立法的现状，并提出了四个供改革者进一步考虑的问题：国家调解立法对提升调解使用率的重要性、成为模范调解法管辖区的意义、调解监管过度模仿仲裁的风险、以及调解法与仲裁法分离考虑的危险。
AI.research_question: 非洲大陆调解立法的现状如何？国家调解立法对调解使用率提升的重要性是什么？成为模范调解法管辖区的意义何在？调解监管过度模仿仲裁的风险是什么？调解法与仲裁法分离考虑的危险是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着非洲大陆对替代性争议解决机制（ADR）需求的增长，调解作为一种重要的争议解决方式受到关注。然而，非洲各国调解立法发展不均衡，需要系统梳理现状并探讨立法改革的关键问题，以促进调解在非洲的有效应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于比较法理论、立法改革理论、替代性争议解决机制（ADR）理论，特别是调解与仲裁的对比分析框架，探讨调解立法的制度设计问题。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和比较分析法，系统梳理2019年非洲各国调解立法现状，通过理论分析提出四个关键问题供改革者考虑。
AI.findings: 总结了非洲大陆调解立法的整体状况，识别了立法不均衡的问题，提出了四个核心问题：1）国家立法对调解使用率的影响；2）模范调解法管辖区的价值；3）调解监管过度模仿仲裁的风险；4）调解法与仲裁法分离考虑的危险。
AI.theory_contributions: 为调解立法理论提供了非洲视角，提出了调解与仲裁关系的新分析框架，丰富了比较调解法研究，为立法改革提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲各国调解立法改革提供了具体问题导向的参考，帮助政策制定者评估立法策略，避免调解监管的常见陷阱，促进调解制度的健康发展。

title: When Systems Fail: The Triangulated Logic of Systemic Failure and the Ethical Erosion of Organisational Judgement

detail.title: When Systems Fail: The Triangulated Logic of Systemic Failure and the Ethical Erosion of Organisational Judgement
detail.abstract: Organisational failure is frequently depicted as a technical or procedural malfunction; however, deeper analysis reveals an ethical and systemic breakdown of judgment. In a world where corporate decisions can cost lives, the need for ethical observation becomes paramount. This study examines the Boeing 737 MAX crisis using the Triangulated Logic of Systemic Failure, a framework that integrates cognitive misjudgement, behavioural arrogance, and emotional disruption. Drawing on Dorner's (1996) theory of failure, Cipolla's (1976) laws of human stupidity, and insights from complexity theory (Morin, 2008) and anxiety studies (Greenberg et al., 1986), the model reveals how intelligent organisations can become self-defeating under pressure. Boeing's decisions, influenced by competitive anxiety and internal overconfidence, demonstrate how ethical blindness may arise from the convergence of cognitive overload, ego-driven incentives, and fear-based defensiveness. Comparative cases from NASA's Challenger disaster and Volkswagen's Dieselgate scandal reinforce the recurring pattern of systemic drift toward moral disengagement. The analysis extends to ethical and governance implications, providing a reflective framework for leadership that balances performance with integrity. This study not only offers insights into understanding systemic failures but also illustrates practical applications. Managers and students can apply the Triangulated Logic of Systemic Failure by fostering cognitive humility, behavioural integrity, and emotional composure within their teams and organisations. These principles operationalise ethical reflection into organisational resilience, equipping organisational leaders with actionable strategies to anticipate and mitigate potential ethical failures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过波音737 MAX危机等案例，提出了"系统性失败三角逻辑"框架，解释智能组织如何在压力下自我挫败，并为管理者提供预防伦理失败的实用策略。
AI.research_question: 组织失败如何从表面上的技术或程序故障演变为深层的伦理和系统性判断崩溃？特别是智能组织如何在压力下变得自我挫败？
AI.motivation: 企业决策可能危及生命，因此伦理观察变得至关重要。组织失败常被简化为技术问题，但需要深入理解其背后的伦理和系统性根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性失败三角逻辑（整合认知误判、行为傲慢和情绪干扰）、Dorner失败理论、Cipolla人类愚蠢法则、复杂性理论和焦虑研究。
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析波音737 MAX危机，并比较NASA挑战者号灾难和大众柴油门丑闻，识别系统性道德脱离的重复模式。
AI.findings: 波音的决策受竞争焦虑和内部过度自信影响，伦理盲视源于认知超载、自我驱动激励和恐惧防御的汇聚。系统性漂移趋向道德脱离是重复模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统性失败三角逻辑框架，整合多学科理论解释组织伦理崩溃机制，扩展了组织失败理论的理解维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供可操作的策略：培养认知谦逊、行为正直和情绪镇定，将伦理反思转化为组织韧性，预防潜在伦理失败。

title: Successful Employee Brand Equity through Employee Brand Consistency Behavior as an Outcome from Employee Branding Program: an Integrative Conceptual Review
affiliations: Bakrie University, ,  and

detail.title: Successful Employee Brand Equity through Employee Brand Consistency Behavior as an Outcome from Employee Branding Program: an Integrative Conceptual Review
detail.abstract: This study aims to develop a conceptual framework, dimensions, and appropriate indicators for measuring employee brand equity (EBE) from a stakeholder perspective. The research method uses an integrative review approach from various Scopus Q2–Q1 indexed journal references from 2021 to 2025. Through this integrative conceptual review method, EBE will be successfully developed through consistent employee behavior towards the brand (EBCB) as an output of the employee branding program. The studies reviewed indicate that organizations must balance the organizational and individual levels when developing policies to improve EBCB or achieve its precise objectives. This will affect EBE from the perspective of its stakeholders. The novelty of this research shows that leadership must be brand-oriented, not merely transformational. Another thing to consider in its implementation is that organizations must be able to integrate all their programs aligned with their brand values

AI.tldr: 本研究通过整合文献综述方法，从利益相关者视角开发了员工品牌资产的概念框架、维度和测量指标，强调员工品牌一致行为作为员工品牌项目的产出，并提出品牌导向领导力的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何从利益相关者视角开发员工品牌资产的概念框架、维度和测量指标？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏从利益相关者角度系统测量员工品牌资产的框架，需要建立综合性的概念模型来指导实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 员工品牌资产理论、利益相关者理论、员工品牌一致行为理论、品牌导向领导力理论
AI.method: 整合性文献综述方法，分析2021-2025年Scopus Q2-Q1期刊的文献
AI.findings: 成功开发了员工品牌资产的概念框架，强调员工品牌一致行为作为关键产出；组织需要在组织和个人层面平衡政策制定；品牌导向领导力比单纯的变革型领导更重要；组织需要整合所有项目与品牌价值保持一致

title: Overcoming adaptation myopia: Old tensions and new directions in measuring adaptation success
affiliations: and

detail.title: Overcoming adaptation myopia: Old tensions and new directions in measuring adaptation success
detail.abstract: Measuring adaptation success remains a deeply contested and politicised challenge in both research and practice. While efforts to define and evaluate adaptation success have proliferated, they often fail to grapple with deeper social, epistemological, and political tensions underpinning adaptation processes and outcomes. Unpacking how success is defined and measured becomes critical to avoid myopic framings and unlock more effective and just adaptation practices. This paper addresses this gap by drawing on 50 in-depth interviews with leading adaptation experts across regions, disciplines, and sectors. With over 950 years of combined experience, these conversations illuminate the underlying tensions, uncertainties, and opportunities in defining and evaluating adaptation success. A prevailing tension re-emerges between success as process, focused on inclusive decision-making, adaptive governance, and effective implementation; and success as outcome, centred on equitable preparedness, maladaptation avoidance, and integration with development. Wicked problems around adaptation measurement converge around four enduring uncertainties, namely ontological-attributional, technical-methodological, spatial, and temporal. Addressing these problems requires legitimising qualitative methods and emphasising context-specific, continuous measurements that capture the intricacies of adaptation processes and outcomes. This research gets to the heart of ongoing debates about the politics of measurement – what gets measured, why, and by whom – and shows how adaptation uncertainties can be wielded to enable more effective and inclusive planning and practice. Rather than closing debates around what counts as adaptation success, we argue that its ambiguity can open possibilities – inviting scholars and practitioners to rethink what matters, challenge dominant paradigms, and create space for more just, context-rooted, and transformative futures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过50位适应领域专家的深度访谈，探讨了适应成功定义与评估中的深层社会、认识论和政治张力，揭示了过程导向与结果导向的成功观之间的核心矛盾，并提出了解决适应测量中四个持久不确定性的方法。
AI.research_question: 如何定义和评估适应成功？适应测量中存在哪些深层社会、认识论和政治张力？这些张力如何影响适应实践的有效性和公正性？
AI.motivation: 适应成功的测量在研究和实践中仍是一个充满争议和政治化的挑战。现有定义和评估方法往往未能解决支撑适应过程和结果的深层社会、认识论和政治张力，导致短视的框架，阻碍了更有效和公正的适应实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 过程导向的成功观：关注包容性决策、适应性治理和有效实施；2) 结果导向的成功观：关注公平的准备、避免不适应、与发展的整合；3) 测量政治学：探讨"测量什么、为什么测量、由谁测量"的政治维度；4) 适应不确定性理论：包括本体论-归因性、技术-方法论、空间和时间四个维度的不确定性。
AI.method: 对50位来自不同地区、学科和部门的适应领域领先专家进行深度访谈，这些专家拥有超过950年的综合经验，通过对话揭示适应成功定义和评估中的张力、不确定性和机会。
AI.findings: 1) 适应成功的主要张力存在于过程导向和结果导向的成功观之间；2) 适应测量围绕四个持久不确定性展开：本体论-归因性、技术-方法论、空间和时间不确定性；3) 解决这些问题需要使定性方法合法化，并强调捕捉适应过程和结果复杂性的情境特定、持续测量；4) 适应的模糊性可以创造可能性，让学者和实践者重新思考重要事项、挑战主导范式，并为更公正、情境扎根和变革性的未来创造空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统识别了适应成功定义中的核心张力框架；2) 提出了适应测量中四个持久不确定性的分类体系；3) 发展了"测量政治学"在适应领域的应用；4) 论证了适应模糊性的积极潜力，为理论创新提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为适应实践者提供了评估适应成功的多维框架；2) 提出了使定性方法合法化和情境特定测量的具体建议；3) 展示了如何利用适应不确定性来促进更有效和包容的规划与实践；4) 鼓励实践者重新思考适应成功的标准，挑战现有范式，推动更公正的适应实践。

title: Loss-Cutting Equation under JX Theory A Closed Alpha-Axis Kernel for Intelligent Termination under Uncertainty
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Loss-Cutting Equation under JX Theory A Closed Alpha-Axis Kernel for Intelligent Termination under Uncertainty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest associated with this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is theoretical and does not involve human participants or experimental data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We formalize the alpha-axis kernel of JX Theory in a purely static, domainagnostic manner. The static functional is defined as L(x) := R(x)-S(x)-E(x) and extended to the uncertainty-penalized and cognition-corrected form L opt (x) := R(x)-S(x)-E(x)-λ σ 2 (x) + ϕ ∆F (x), where λ ≥ 0 weights instantaneous variance and ϕ ∆F operationalizes belief/frame correction via ∆F (x) := V p (x)-V r (x), the gap between perceived and rational baseline values. Under explicit monotonicity and a sign-change condition, we prove existence and uniqueness of the cut boundary, deliver comparative statics in (λ, ϕ) with precise sign assumptions, and discuss identifiability, including instrumentalvariable and structural estimation routes. Dynamic optimal stopping (HJB with free boundaries) is scoped to a companion paper.

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化JX理论的alpha轴核，提出静态泛函L(x)=R(x)-S(x)-E(x)，并扩展为不确定性惩罚和认知校正形式L_opt(x)=R(x)-S(x)-E(x)-λσ²(x)+φΔF(x)，证明切割边界的存在唯一性，提供比较静态分析，讨论识别问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在静态、领域无关的框架下形式化JX理论的alpha轴核？如何证明切割边界的存在性和唯一性？如何分析不确定性惩罚参数λ和认知校正参数φ的比较静态效应？
AI.motivation: 需要为JX理论的alpha轴核提供一个严格的数学形式化框架，使其具有静态性和领域无关性，同时纳入不确定性惩罚和认知校正机制，为后续动态最优停止问题奠定理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于JX理论，构建静态泛函框架，引入不确定性惩罚（方差项）和认知校正（感知价值与理性价值差距），在单调性和符号变化条件下建立切割边界理论。
AI.method: 采用数学形式化方法，定义静态泛函及其扩展形式，运用存在唯一性定理证明切割边界，进行参数比较静态分析，讨论识别策略包括工具变量和结构估计方法。
AI.findings: 在明确的单调性和符号变化条件下，证明了切割边界的存在性和唯一性；给出了参数(λ, φ)的比较静态分析结果，包括精确的符号假设；讨论了识别问题的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为JX理论的alpha轴核提供了第一个静态、领域无关的形式化框架；2) 建立了包含不确定性惩罚和认知校正的扩展泛函；3) 证明了切割边界的存在唯一性定理；4) 提供了完整的比较静态分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为实际决策问题提供了可操作的静态分析工具；2) 识别策略（工具变量、结构估计）为实证研究提供了方法论指导；3) 为后续动态最优停止问题的研究奠定了基础。

title: What Does Consulting Do
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: What Does Consulting Do

publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides the first systematic and comprehensive empirical study of management and strategy consulting. We unveil the workings of this opaque industry by drawing on universal administrative business-to-business transaction data based on value-added tax links from Belgium (2002-2023). These data permit us to document the nature of consulting engagements, take-up patterns, and the effects on client firms. We document that consulting take-up is concentrated among large, high-labor-productivity firms. For TFP and profitability, we find a U-shaped pattern: both high and low performers hire consultants. New clients spend on average 3 % of payroll on consulting, typically in episodic engagements lasting less than one year. Using difference-in-differences designs exploiting these sharp consulting events, we find positive effects on labor productivity of 3.6% over five years, driven by modest employment reductions alongside stable or growing revenue. Average wages rise by 2.7% with no decline in labor’s share of value added, suggesting productivity gains do not come at workers’ expense through rent-shifting. We do observe organizational restructuring with small increases in dismissal rates, and higher services procurement but reduced labor outsourcing. Our heterogeneity analysis reveals larger productivity gains for initially less productive firms, suggesting improvements in allocative efficiency. Our findings broadly align with ex-ante predictions from surveyed academic economists and consulting professionals, validating the productivity- enhancing view of consulting endorsed by most practitioners though only half of academics, while lending less support to a rent-shifting view favored by many economists.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统全面地实证研究了管理战略咨询行业。利用比利时增值税交易数据（2002-2023），发现咨询需求集中在大型高生产率企业，呈现U型模式。新客户平均花费工资总额3%用于咨询，通常为短期项目。双重差分分析显示咨询使劳动生产率提高3.6%，工资增长2.7%，支持咨询提升生产率的观点而非租金转移理论。
AI.research_question: 管理战略咨询服务的采用模式及其对客户企业的影响是什么？咨询是否真正提升企业生产率，还是仅仅进行租金转移？
AI.motivation: 管理咨询行业虽然规模庞大且影响广泛，但一直缺乏系统性实证研究。行业不透明性使得人们对其实际效果存在争议：一方认为咨询提升企业效率，另一方认为咨询只是租金转移工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要涉及两个竞争性理论框架：1）生产率提升理论（咨询改善管理实践，提高效率）；2）租金转移理论（咨询帮助企业从员工处转移租金，而非真正提升效率）。
AI.method: 使用比利时2002-2023年基于增值税的B2B交易行政数据。采用双重差分设计，利用咨询服务的突然采用作为处理事件，分析咨询对客户企业的影响。
AI.findings: 1）咨询需求集中在大型高劳动生产率企业，呈现U型模式（高低绩效企业都采用）；2）新客户平均花费工资总额3%用于咨询，多为短期项目；3）咨询使劳动生产率提高3.6%，工资增长2.7%，劳动力份额未下降；4）组织重组：解雇率小幅上升，服务采购增加但劳动力外包减少；5）初始低生产率企业获益更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次系统实证检验咨询行业，填补研究空白；2）支持生产率提升理论而非租金转移理论；3）揭示咨询采用模式的异质性（U型模式）；4）验证了学术经济学家与咨询从业者的事前预测差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业决策提供实证依据：咨询确实能提升生产率；2）为政策制定者提供参考：咨询行业促进资源优化配置；3）为咨询行业提供透明度：揭示行业运作模式；4）为员工提供保障：生产率提升不损害劳动者利益。

title: The Double Cab Controversy in Sri Lanka: Procurement Duplicity, Regressive Policy, and the Crisis of Political Legitimacy in Post-Crisis Democracies
affiliations: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology

detail.title: The Double Cab Controversy in Sri Lanka: Procurement Duplicity, Regressive Policy, and the Crisis of Political Legitimacy in Post-Crisis Democracies
detail.abstract: This article examines the 2025-2026 "Double Cab Controversy" in Sri Lanka as a critical case study of governance failure in post-crisis democracies. Following the National People's Power (NPP) coalition's electoral victory on an anti-corruption platform, the government's proposal to procure 1,775 double cab pickup trucks for Rs. 12.5 billion sparked signi�icant political controversy. Through qualitative case study methodology, this research analyzes allegations of procurement manipulation, critiques the regressive policy shift from duty-free permits to state-owned vehicle �leets, and examines implications for political legitimacy. Drawing on institutional economics, public administration theory, and governance literature, the study reveals a critical gap between campaign promises and governing praxis. The �indings demonstrate how procedural opacity, �iscal irresponsibility, and policy reversals can rapidly erode public trust in reformist governments, offering broader lessons for post-crisis democratic transitions.

AI.tldr: 该研究以斯里兰卡2025-2026年"双排座皮卡争议"为案例，分析后危机民主国家的治理失败，揭示改革派政府竞选承诺与执政实践之间的差距如何快速侵蚀公众信任。
AI.research_question: 斯里兰卡2025-2026年"双排座皮卡争议"如何体现后危机民主国家的治理失败？
AI.motivation: 研究后危机民主国家中改革派政府竞选承诺与执政实践之间的差距，以及这种差距如何影响政治合法性和公众信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学、公共行政理论、治理文献
AI.method: 定性案例研究方法
AI.findings: 程序不透明、财政不负责任和政策逆转会迅速侵蚀改革派政府的公众信任；揭示了竞选承诺与执政实践之间的关键差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 为后危机民主转型的治理失败理论提供了实证案例；深化了对改革派政府合法性危机的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后危机民主国家的政策制定者提供警示：程序透明度、财政责任和政策一致性对维持政治合法性至关重要。

title: The Missing Middle: Behavioural Drift, Safety Risk, and the Erosion of Middle Management in Community Care Settings

detail.title: The Missing Middle: Behavioural Drift, Safety Risk, and the Erosion of Middle Management in Community Care Settings
detail.abstract: This paper examines the erosion of middle management as a source of behavioural governance in contemporary organisations. While management discourse increasingly promotes flattened hierarchies and self-managing teams, the behavioural and safety consequences of these shifts remain underexplored. Drawing on a qualitative case vignette from a community-based intellectual disability care organisation in New Zealand, the paper shows how middle management roles may persist structurally while becoming functionally weakened in practice. Integrating organisational safety and learning literature-including Reason's model of organisational accidents, Vaughan's concept of normalisation of deviance, and Edmondson's work on psychological safety-the analysis demonstrates how weakened middle management contributes to behavioural drift, declining incident reporting, and the accumulation of latent safety risks. In the absence of sustained managerial presence and reinforcement, behavioural responsibility migrates downward and becomes governed by informal power dynamics rather than professional norms. The paper argues that the erosion of middle management represents a design failure rather than an individual or cultural deficiency. Behavioural governance does not disappear when hierarchies are flattened; it is displaced. When this displacement is unacknowledged, organisations become increasingly reliant on silence and luck rather than on early detection and learning to maintain safety. The findings highlight the need to reframe middle management as behavioural infrastructure and to treat behavioural authority as a core organisational design concern, particularly in high-risk and care-based environments.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了中层管理在当代组织行为治理中的侵蚀现象，通过新西兰社区智障护理机构的案例研究，揭示了中层管理结构上存在但功能弱化如何导致行为漂移、事故报告减少和安全风险累积。
AI.research_question: 中层管理在组织行为治理中的作用如何被削弱？这种削弱对组织安全、行为规范和事故报告机制产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 当前管理话语强调扁平化层级和自我管理团队，但这些转变对行为和安全的影响尚未得到充分研究。组织在追求效率的同时可能忽视了中层管理在行为治理中的关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了组织安全与学习文献：Reason的组织事故模型、Vaughan的偏差正常化概念、Edmondson的心理安全理论。
AI.method: 采用质性案例研究方法，以新西兰社区智障护理组织为案例进行深入分析。
AI.findings: 中层管理角色结构上存在但功能弱化，导致行为责任下移，由非正式权力动态而非专业规范治理；这造成行为漂移、事故报告减少、潜在安全风险累积；组织越来越依赖沉默和运气而非早期检测和学习来维持安全。
AI.theory_contributions: 将中层管理重新定义为行为基础设施；提出行为权威应作为核心组织设计考量；将中层管理侵蚀视为设计失败而非个人或文化缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调在高风险和护理环境中需要重新评估中层管理的价值；建议组织应明确行为治理的责任分配；提倡将行为权威纳入组织设计考量。

title: A Decision Support System for Fertilizer Distribution in East Java Province using Hybrid AHP-TOPSIS Method: A Supply Chain Management Approach
affiliations: and

detail.title: A Decision Support System for Fertilizer Distribution in East Java Province using Hybrid AHP-TOPSIS Method: A Supply Chain Management Approach
detail.abstract: As an agrarian country, Indonesia requires an efficient fertilizer distribution system to support agricultural productivity. East Java Province, as a leading food producer, needs a decision-support system to optimize fertilizer allocation and distribution. This research develops a decision-support system based on the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) and the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) to optimize fertilizer distribution in East Java. The system considers eight criteria: land area, urea allocation, urea distribution, ZA allocation, ZA distribution, NPK allocation, NPK distribution, and primary commodities. Data used in this study include the Dataset Alokasi Distribusi Pupuk Provinsi Jawa Timur 2023–2024 (Fertilizer Allocation Dataset of East Java Province 2023–2024), Dataset Salur Distribusi Pupuk Provinsi Jawa Timur 2023–2024 (Fertilizer Distribution Delivery Dataset of East Java Province 2023–2024), Luas Panen Padi Menurut Kabupaten/Kota 2024 (Rice Harvested Area by Regency/City 2024), agricultural land area in East Java (luas lahan pertanian di Jawa Timur), and the Harvest Area, Production, and Productivity of Corn and Soybeans by Regency/City in East Java Province (luas panen, produksi, dan produktivitas jagung dan kedelai menurut kabupaten/kota di Provinsi Jawa Timur). Research results show that the AHP-TOPSIS system can provide accurate rankings of fertilizer distribution priorities based on predetermined criteria. This system can help decision-makers optimize resource allocation and improve the efficiency of the fertilizer supply chain in East Java.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于AHP-TOPSIS的决策支持系统，用于优化印度尼西亚东爪哇省的化肥分配。系统考虑了8个标准，能够为决策者提供准确的化肥分配优先级排序。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个有效的决策支持系统来优化东爪哇省的化肥分配？
AI.motivation: 作为农业国家，印度尼西亚需要高效的化肥分配系统来支持农业生产率。东爪哇省作为主要粮食产区，需要优化化肥分配和配送的决策支持系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 层次分析法(AHP)和理想解相似度排序法(TOPSIS)的多标准决策分析框架。
AI.method: 采用AHP-TOPSIS集成方法，考虑8个标准：土地面积、尿素分配、尿素配送、ZA分配、ZA配送、NPK分配、NPK配送和主要商品。使用东爪哇省2023-2024年的化肥分配数据集、水稻收获面积数据、农业用地面积数据以及玉米和大豆的生产数据。
AI.findings: AHP-TOPSIS系统能够基于预定标准提供准确的化肥分配优先级排序，帮助优化资源配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AHP和TOPSIS方法集成应用于农业供应链优化，为多标准决策支持系统在农业资源分配中的应用提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东爪哇省决策者提供了一个实用的化肥分配优化工具，能够提高化肥供应链效率，支持农业生产力提升。

title: The Correlation Between Corruption and Weak Human Development
affiliations: Bakrie University

detail.title: The Correlation Between Corruption and Weak Human Development
detail.abstract: Corruption remains a persistent obstacle to sustainable human development, particularly in developing countries. It undermines public service delivery, weakens institutions, and reduces the effectiveness of policies aimed at improving education, health, and social welfare. Conversely, weak human development may also reinforce corruption.  This study investigates the relationship between corruption and human development using a quantitative correlation approach. The analysis is based on a dataset comprising 199 data points from 75 countries, covering the period from 2013 to 2022. Four key indicators are utilized, namely the Corruption Perception Index (CPI), Human Development Index (HDI), PISA scores, and the Economist Intelligence Unit’s Democracy Index. The findings indicate a fairly strong and statistically significant negative correlation between corruption levels and human development outcomes. Higher corruption is consistently associated with lower HDI scores, weaker educational performance (as measured by PISA), and diminished democratic quality. These results highlight a reciprocal relationship, where high levels of corruption hinder human development, and weak human development environments in areas such as education and governance create conditions that allow corruption to thrive. The study concludes that embedding integrity-based education constitutes a normative foundation for breaking the vicious cycle of corruption and advancing sustainable human development.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定量相关分析发现腐败与人类发展之间存在显著的负相关关系：腐败程度越高，人类发展指数（HDI）、教育表现（PISA）和民主质量越低。研究揭示了腐败与人类发展之间的恶性循环关系，并建议将诚信教育作为打破这一循环、促进可持续发展的规范性基础。
AI.research_question: 腐败与人类发展之间存在着怎样的关系？这种关系是单向的还是相互影响的？
AI.motivation: 腐败是发展中国家可持续发展的主要障碍，它破坏公共服务、削弱制度、降低教育、健康和社会福利政策的有效性。同时，薄弱的人类发展也可能助长腐败。理解这种双向关系对于制定有效的反腐败和发展政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于腐败与人类发展相互关系的理论框架，探讨腐败如何通过制度弱化、资源错配等机制阻碍人类发展，以及薄弱的人类发展（特别是教育和治理）如何为腐败创造有利条件。
AI.method: 采用定量相关分析方法，使用199个数据点（来自75个国家，2013-2022年）的数据集。关键指标包括：腐败感知指数（CPI）、人类发展指数（HDI）、PISA分数和经济学人智库民主指数。
AI.findings: 研究发现腐败水平与人类发展成果之间存在相当强且统计显著的负相关关系：腐败程度越高，HDI得分越低，教育表现（PISA）越差，民主质量越弱。这表明腐败与人类发展之间存在相互强化的恶性循环关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于实证验证了腐败与人类发展之间的双向因果关系，丰富了关于制度质量与发展成果关系的理论，为理解腐败如何通过多种渠道阻碍可持续发展提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于强调了诚信教育作为打破腐败与人类发展恶性循环的关键策略，为政策制定者提供了基于证据的反腐败干预方向，特别是在教育体系和治理改革方面。

title: Communication, Culture, and Media in the Digital Era: The Case of Sound Branding in Destination, Rammang-Rammang Geosite, South Sulawesi
affiliations: Bakrie University, , Bakrie University and

detail.title: Communication, Culture, and Media in the Digital Era: The Case of Sound Branding in Destination, Rammang-Rammang Geosite, South Sulawesi

keywords.keywords: Communication; Culture; Media; Sound Branding; Geotourism; Geosite Rammang-Rammang

detail.abstract: In the digital era, communication, culture, and media converge on multimodal platforms where meaning is shaped not only through text and image but increasingly through sound. While communication research has long emphasized the visual turn (Rose, 2016; Manovich, 2020), emerging scholarship highlights sound as a formative communicative resource that encodes affect, identity, and cultural memory (Sterne, 2012; Bull, 2000). Building on this shift, this study examines how natural soundscapes become strategic assets for destination communication and branding within geotourism. Rammang-Rammang Geosite in South Sulawesi offers an illuminating case: its immersive sonic environment—limestone echoes, mangrove rustling, endemic bird calls, and profound silences—constitutes a cultural text through which the landscape is sensed and interpreted. Empirical findings from Murtadha (2025) show that visitors associate these auditory patterns with tranquility, awe, and place-belonging, whereas intrusive anthropogenic noise disrupts affective engagement. These insights align with Schafer’s (1994) notion of soundscape and Clynes’s (1977) Sentic Theory linking acoustic patterns to embodied emotional response. The study further demonstrates that sound branding extends beyond on-site experience into digital mediation. Recordings circulating through social media and tourism platforms translate local auditory identity into a globally legible narrative, while simultaneously raising concerns about the commodification of ecological sounds. When practiced responsibly, however, digital sound branding can support conservation-oriented communication by foregrounding silence, natural rhythms, and ecological fragility as elements of sustainable tourism storytelling (UNESCO, 2021). Ultimately, Rammang-Rammang illustrates that sound branding is not merely a marketing technique but a communicative practice rooted in ecological experience and cultural meaning-making, generating narratives that are both embodied and digitally resonant

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在数字时代，自然声景如何成为地理旅游目的地传播和品牌建设的战略资产。通过对南苏拉威西Rammang-Rammang地质公园的案例研究，发现自然声音（石灰岩回声、红树林沙沙声、特有鸟鸣声）能唤起游客的宁静感、敬畏感和归属感，而人为噪音则会破坏情感参与。研究还表明，声音品牌不仅限于现场体验，还延伸到数字传播中，但需要负责任地处理生态声音的商品化问题。
AI.research_question: 自然声景如何成为地理旅游目的地传播和品牌建设的战略资产？数字声音品牌如何影响游客的情感参与和生态保护意识？
AI.motivation: 当前传播研究长期强调"视觉转向"，但新兴学术研究指出声音是塑造意义的重要沟通资源。在数字时代，声音作为编码情感、身份和文化记忆的媒介，在地理旅游目的地品牌建设中具有重要价值，但相关研究相对缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 声景理论（Schafer, 1994）：将声景视为文化文本
2. Sentic理论（Clynes, 1977）：声学模式与具身情感反应的关联
3. 声音作为沟通资源（Sterne, 2012; Bull, 2000）
4. 可持续旅游叙事（UNESCO, 2021）
AI.method: 案例研究法：以南苏拉威西Rammang-Rammang地质公园为案例，分析其沉浸式声学环境（石灰岩回声、红树林沙沙声、特有鸟鸣声、深刻寂静）如何构成文化文本。基于Murtadha（2025）的实证发现，探讨游客对声景的情感反应和数字声音品牌的传播效果。
AI.findings:
1. 游客将自然声景（石灰岩回声、红树林沙沙声、鸟鸣声）与宁静感、敬畏感和场所归属感相关联
2. 人为噪音会破坏游客的情感参与和体验质量
3. 声音品牌通过社交媒体和旅游平台实现数字传播，将地方听觉身份转化为全球可理解的叙事
4. 数字声音品牌存在生态声音商品化的风险，但负责任的使用可以支持保护导向的传播
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将声音研究从"视觉转向"的补充扩展为独立的沟通资源研究
2. 整合声景理论和Sentic理论，建立声学模式与情感反应的系统框架
3. 提出声音品牌作为根植于生态体验和文化意义创造的沟通实践
4. 拓展了可持续旅游叙事中声音维度的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为地理旅游目的地提供基于声景的品牌建设策略
2. 指导旅游管理者减少人为噪音，保护自然声景完整性
3. 为数字声音品牌实践提供负责任传播的指导原则
4. 支持生态保护导向的旅游传播，通过声音叙事提升游客的环保意识

title: Cooperation in a Dynamic Network
affiliations: Microsoft Research, Microsoft Research, Washington University in St. Louis and

detail.title: Cooperation in a Dynamic Network
detail.abstract: We study the scope for cooperation in an evolving network. Under endogenous dynamics, cooperation leads to a growing neighborhood of long-term productive relationships, while defection exploits ephemeral relationships resulting in social marginalization. We characterize a class of simple stationary equilibria in which, even as players become patient, the coexistence of cooperation and defection naturally arises. This captures the observation that many social networks are characterized by a high, though not universal, level of cooperation.  Low levels of cooperation can be sustained only through exclusivity among cooperating agents.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了演化网络中的合作可能性，发现合作能建立长期生产性关系网络，而背叛则导致社会边缘化。研究识别了一类简单稳态均衡，其中合作与背叛自然共存，解释了现实中社会网络普遍存在高水平但非完全合作的现象。
AI.research_question: 在演化网络中，合作与背叛如何共存？什么因素决定了社会网络中合作水平的持续性？
AI.motivation: 现实社会网络通常表现出高水平但非完全的合作，需要理论解释这种合作与背叛共存的现象，以及网络演化如何影响合作动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈理论、网络形成理论、重复博弈中的合作演化理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建演化网络中的博弈模型，分析内生动态下的均衡特征
AI.findings: 1. 合作促进长期生产性关系网络的形成，背叛导致短期关系和社会边缘化；2. 存在一类简单稳态均衡，即使参与者变得耐心，合作与背叛也能自然共存；3. 低水平合作只能通过合作者之间的排他性来维持
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为演化网络中合作与背叛共存提供了理论解释；2. 识别了网络内生动态如何影响合作演化；3. 解释了为什么社会网络通常表现出高水平但非完全的合作
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解现实社会网络中的合作模式提供框架；2. 揭示了促进合作需要建立长期关系网络；3. 为组织设计和社会政策提供启示，说明如何通过关系结构维持合作

title: Analysis of Consumer Risk Factors on P2P Company Credit Performance Using the 5C Credit Principles PT XYZ
affiliations: Harapan Bangsa Business School,  and

detail.title: Analysis of Consumer Risk Factors on P2P Company Credit Performance Using the 5C Credit Principles PT XYZ
detail.abstract: Currently, technological developments are a crucial factor in running any business. Technology is no longer merely a supporting element, its role being to record and standardize transactions to facilitate retrieval and auditing. The government fully supports this, as does the Ministry of Communication and Information and the Financial Services Authority (OJK), whose regulatory role is to standardize digital processes and reduce face-to-face interactions, thereby streamlining the process: PT XYZ, a subsidiary of PT. Astra International Tbk (ASII), branded Maucash, a financial technology company in Indonesia, experienced a similar situation: an increase in bad customers from 2020 to 2021. By focusing on these three factors (Character, Capacity, and Condition), the researcher aimed to determine which variables influence lending decisions, thereby minimizing future bad customers, which ultimately impact the company's profits. The research sample consisted of respondents selected from customers across all criteria at Maucash. Data analysis was conducted using logistic regression. The results show that the variables with potential to reduce the risk of default are education, salary interval, industry, and length of service. Variables that may increase the risk of default include female gender, device used, loan purpose, home ownership, source of income, and monthly income.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了金融科技公司Maucash中影响贷款决策的关键因素，通过逻辑回归分析识别出能够减少违约风险（教育、薪资区间、行业、服务年限）和增加违约风险（女性性别、使用设备、贷款目的、房屋所有权、收入来源、月收入）的变量，旨在帮助公司优化信贷决策并减少坏账。
AI.research_question: 哪些变量（基于Character、Capacity、Condition三个维度）影响金融科技公司Maucash的贷款决策，从而能够最小化未来坏账客户？
AI.motivation: PT XYZ（Maucash）作为印尼金融科技公司，在2020-2021年间经历了坏账客户的增加，这影响了公司利润。同时，印尼政府（通信和信息部及金融服务管理局）积极推动数字化转型和标准化流程，减少面对面交互。因此，需要识别影响贷款决策的关键因素来优化风险管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷评估的"3C"框架：Character（品格）、Capacity（能力）、Condition（条件）。该框架常用于评估借款人的信用风险，本研究将其操作化为具体变量进行分析。
AI.method: 从Maucash所有标准客户中选取研究样本，使用逻辑回归进行数据分析，识别影响贷款违约风险的变量。
AI.findings: 减少违约风险的变量：教育水平、薪资区间、行业类型、服务年限。增加违约风险的变量：女性性别、使用设备类型、贷款目的、房屋所有权状况、收入来源、月收入水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了3C信贷评估框架在金融科技环境下的应用，为数字信贷风险评估提供了实证证据，识别了在传统银行信贷和金融科技环境中可能表现不同的风险因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Maucash和其他金融科技公司提供了具体的风险识别指标，可优化贷款审批决策系统，减少坏账损失，提高盈利能力。同时支持了印尼政府推动的数字化金融服务标准化进程。

title: The Agentic AI Governance Framework: A Universal Model for Risk, Accountability, and Compliance in Autonomous Systems

detail.title: The Agentic AI Governance Framework: A Universal Model for Risk, Accountability, and Compliance in Autonomous Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, design, or conclusions of this paper. The concepts and models described, including the Agentic Log Retention Index (ALRI) and the Six Governance Principles, were developed independently as part of the author’s ongoing research at Mindscope AI LLP
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, personal data collection, or experiments requiring ethical approval. It is a conceptual and methodological study focused on governance models, risk frameworks, and agentic system accountability in artificial intelligence.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author and supported through Mindscope AI LLP, an independent automation and AI consulting practice. No external grants, corporate sponsorships, or institutional funding were received for the preparation or publication of this work.

detail.abstract:
The rapid and enthusiastic interest in development and deployment of Agentic AI and especially autonomous agents which are capable of independent reasoning, leveraging and  executing tools, has outpaced the definition of governance mechanism that is required to manage their operational, ethical and regulatory risks.There are existing AI governance models like NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, do provide foundational controls however, they are very generic and lack the implementation depth for these conitnuously acting, multi-agent systems.

This paper introduces The Agentic AI Governance Framework, which is a six principled lifecycle model designed to ensure traceability, accountability, and regulatory alignment across agentic deployments. The framework formalizes quantifiable controls through two applied mechanisms: the Agentic Log Retention Index (ALRI), which defines evidenceretention periods based on agent risk and jurisdiction, and a Runtime Governance Architecture integrating human-in-loop escalation, tool-access allow-lists, and modelprovenance capture. Implementation mappings are provided for major orchestration environments including LangChain, Power Platform, and UiPath. 

Adoption of the framework enables organizations to reconstruct agentic decisions within 24 hours, achieve ≥ 95 % provenance coverage, and detect behavioral drift within 10 % variance. The proposed model bridges the current gap between compliance principles and deployable governance practice, establishing a reusable baseline for safe and auditable Agentic AI operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个代理AI治理框架，通过六个原则的生命周期模型确保代理部署的可追溯性、责任性和监管合规性，包含ALRI指标和运行时治理架构等具体机制。
AI.research_question: 如何为自主代理AI系统设计一个可实施的治理框架，以管理其操作、伦理和监管风险？
AI.motivation: 代理AI和自主代理的快速发展已超过了治理机制的定义，现有AI治理模型（如NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001）过于通用，缺乏针对持续运行的多代理系统的实施深度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理AI治理框架，基于六个原则的生命周期模型，整合了可追溯性、责任性和监管一致性原则。
AI.method: 提出一个包含两个应用机制的框架：1) 代理日志保留指数（ALRI），基于代理风险和司法管辖区定义证据保留期；2) 运行时治理架构，集成人在环升级、工具访问白名单和模型来源捕获。
AI.findings: 采用该框架可使组织在24小时内重建代理决策，实现≥95%的来源覆盖，并在10%方差内检测行为漂移。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了代理AI治理的理论框架，将合规原则与可部署的治理实践相连接，为安全可审计的代理AI操作提供了可重复的基线。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了针对LangChain、Power Platform和UiPath等主要编排环境的实施映射，使组织能够实际应用该治理框架。

title: The Impact of Short-Time Work During the Great Recession
affiliations: Gent University, Ghent University - Department of Economics and

detail.title: The Impact of Short-Time Work During the Great Recession

keywords.keywords: Short-time work; employment; wages; unemployment insurance.

publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We evaluate the effectiveness of Belgium’s short-time work (STW) program during the Great Recession, a period when the country recorded the highest STW take-up rate in Europe. STW allows firms to reduce working hours in response to temporary shocks while avoiding layoffs, playing a key role in European labor market insurance systems. Using an instrumental variable strategy that exploits quasi-exogenous variation stemming from an institutional feature of the Belgian program, we estimate the causal effects of STW on employment and wages. We find that, while STW significantly reduces the volume of work per worker, it does not lead to statistically significant employment gains for the average treated firm. Importantly, positive employment effects are concentrated among small manufacturing firms, which are more likely to face binding liquidity constraints. These findings highlight the importance of targeting and screening in improving the cost-effectiveness of STW programs and minimizing deadweight losses.

AI.tldr: 比利时短期工作计划在金融危机期间对就业影响有限，仅在小规模制造业企业中产生积极就业效应，突显了精准定向和筛选对提高计划成本效益的重要性。
AI.research_question: 比利时短期工作计划在金融危机期间对就业和工资的因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 比利时在金融危机期间拥有欧洲最高的短期工作计划使用率，但该计划的实际效果缺乏因果证据，需要评估其就业保护效果和成本效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场保险理论、企业流动性约束理论、短期工作计划的经济学分析
AI.method: 工具变量策略，利用比利时短期工作计划制度特征的准外生变异来估计因果效应
AI.findings: 1. 短期工作计划显著减少了每个工人的工作量；2. 对平均处理企业没有产生统计显著的就业增长；3. 积极的就业效应集中在面临流动性约束的小型制造业企业
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了短期工作计划因果效应的经验证据；2. 揭示了企业异质性（规模和行业）对政策效果的影响；3. 强调了流动性约束在政策有效性中的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改进短期工作计划成本效益的建议；2. 强调需要针对小型制造业企业进行精准定向；3. 建议加强筛选机制以减少无效支出

title: Startup Dynamics in Indonesia: Leveraging Lean Startup and Dynamic Capabilities for Growth and Sustainability
affiliations: Trisakti Institute of Tourism, Trisakti Institute of Tourism, Trisakti Institute of Tourism, Trisakti Institute of Tourism and Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB)

detail.title: Startup Dynamics in Indonesia: Leveraging Lean Startup and Dynamic Capabilities for Growth and Sustainability
detail.abstract: This study examines the development trajectory of digital startups in Indonesia by integrating Dynamic Capabilities Theory and the Lean Startup methodology. Employing a qualitative case study approach, we conducted semi-structured interviews with twelve senior executives and ecosystem enablers across fintech and healthtech sectors to explore how early-stage ventures navigate critical developmental phases. The research identifies six distinct stages of startup development—ideation, pre-seed, seed, launch and growth, maturity, and exit strategy—each characterized by unique challenges and strategic imperatives. Our findings reveal that successful startups leverage dynamic capabilities through iterative learning, rapid MVP experimentation, and continuous market feedback adaptation to achieve product-market fit despite resource constraints and regulatory uncertainties. The study highlights the instrumental role of Indonesia's startup ecosystem, particularly incubators, accelerators, and government initiatives, in providing critical resources and mentorship that enhance survival rates. However, significant challenges persist, including uneven geographic distribution of support services, suboptimal incubator effectiveness, and regulatory ambiguities. The research demonstrates that integrating dynamic capabilities with Lean Startup practices enables startups in emerging economies to overcome institutional challenges by enhancing sensing, seizing, and transforming capabilities. These findings offer valuable insights for policymakers designing supportive frameworks and practitioners seeking sustainable growth strategies in Indonesia's rapidly evolving digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究整合动态能力理论和精益创业方法论，探讨印尼数字初创企业的发展轨迹。通过定性案例研究发现初创企业经历六个发展阶段，成功企业通过迭代学习、快速MVP实验和持续市场反馈适应来实现产品市场契合，印尼创业生态系统提供关键支持但面临地理分布不均、孵化器效果不佳等挑战。
AI.research_question: 印尼数字初创企业如何通过整合动态能力理论和精益创业方法论来应对发展过程中的关键阶段挑战？
AI.motivation: 研究印尼作为新兴经济体中数字初创企业的发展轨迹，探索在资源约束和监管不确定性环境下，初创企业如何通过特定战略实现可持续增长，为政策制定者和实践者提供见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（Dynamic Capabilities Theory）和精益创业方法论（Lean Startup methodology）的整合框架。
AI.method: 定性案例研究，对金融科技和健康科技领域的12位高级管理人员和生态系统推动者进行半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: 1. 识别出初创企业发展的六个阶段：构思、种子前、种子期、启动与增长、成熟、退出策略；2. 成功初创企业通过迭代学习、快速MVP实验和持续市场反馈适应来实现产品市场契合；3. 印尼创业生态系统（孵化器、加速器、政府倡议）提供关键资源但面临地理分布不均、孵化器效果不佳等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将动态能力理论与精益创业方法论整合，为新兴经济体初创企业研究提供新理论框架；2. 展示了动态能力（感知、捕捉、转型）如何通过精益创业实践得到增强；3. 扩展了动态能力理论在资源约束环境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计支持性框架提供见解；2. 为实践者提供可持续增长策略指导；3. 帮助生态系统参与者优化支持服务；4. 为初创企业提供阶段化发展路径参考。

title: A Comprehensive Legal Analysis of the Regulation on a Unified Digital Identity: Implications for Strengthening Legal Accountability among Indonesian Citizens
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: A Comprehensive Legal Analysis of the Regulation on a Unified Digital Identity: Implications for Strengthening Legal Accountability among Indonesian Citizens
detail.abstract: The advancement of technology has positioned social media as a primary necessity, primarily serving as a medium for communication and information exchange. Among the most widely used platforms in Indonesia are Instagram and TikTok. However, the widespread use of social media has also given rise to various negative phenomena, including hate speech, the spread of disinformation (hoaxes), threats, doxing, and cyberbullying. A significant challenge in addressing cybercrime is identifying perpetrators, often due to the use of fake accounts and online anonymity. Anonymity, therefore, becomes a root issue, enabling individuals to act with impunity and without fear of legal consequences. In response, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs has proposed regulating a Single Digital Identity (Identitas Digital Tunggal/IDT), which would limit each person to a single social media account. This measure is designed as a strategic initiative to protect the public from cybercrime and promote user accountability. Nonetheless, such a policy may affect citizens' constitutional right to freedom of expression, raising a fundamental tension between legal protection and civil liberties. This study aims to provide a juridical review of the constitutional position of the right to freedom of expression on social media, based on the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and relevant legislation, including Law No. 1 of 2024 concerning the Second Amendment to Law No. 11 of 2008 on Electronic Information and Transactions (ITE Law). Employing normative juridical research and secondary data, this study finds that while freedom of expression on social media is constitutionally protected, its exercise is subject to limitations under statutory law, particularly the ITE Law, which prohibits specific categories of content.

AI.tldr: 该研究对印尼政府提出的单一数字身份政策进行法学审查，分析社交媒体言论自由与网络犯罪防治之间的宪法冲突，认为言论自由虽受宪法保护但受《电子交易法》限制。
AI.research_question: 在印尼宪法框架下，社交媒体上的言论自由权利与政府提出的单一数字身份政策之间的法律关系如何？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体在印尼广泛使用（如Instagram和TikTok），但伴随网络犯罪问题（仇恨言论、虚假信息、网络欺凌等）。匿名性是关键问题，政府提出单一数字身份政策来应对，但这可能影响公民宪法权利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于1945年印尼共和国宪法和相关立法，包括2024年第1号法律（《电子交易法》第二次修订）。
AI.method: 采用规范性法学研究和二手数据分析。
AI.findings: 社交媒体言论自由受宪法保护，但受成文法限制，特别是《电子交易法》禁止特定类别内容。

PLEASE CITE THE PUBLISHED VERSION:

Akusta, E. (2025). Analysis of provincial export performance in Türkiye: A spectral clustering approach. Firat University Journal of Social Sciences, 35(1), 123–140. https://doi.org/10.18069/firatsbed.1506892

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


This study analyzes and clusters Türkiye's 81 provinces based on their export performance. Import, export and net export data for 2023 are used in this study. In addition, exchange rateadjusted versions of the data were also included to eliminate the effects of exchange rate fluctuations. Spectral clustering method is used to group the export performance of cities. The optimum number of clusters was determined by the Eigen-Gap method. The Silhouette coefficient method was used to evaluate the clustering performance. As a result of the analysis, it was determined that the data set was optimally separated into 3 clusters. Spectral-clustering analysis based on export performance showed that 42% of the provinces are in the "Low", 33% in the "Medium" and 25% in the "High" export performance category. In terms of import performance, 44%, 33%, 33%, and 22% of the provinces are in the "Medium", "High", and "Low" categories, respectively. In terms of net exports, 38, 35% and 27% of the provinces are in the "Low", "Medium" and "High" net export performance categories, respectively. İzmir has the highest net export performance, while İstanbul has the lowest.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用谱聚类方法分析土耳其81个省份的出口表现，基于2023年进出口数据，识别出三个集群：低、中、高出口表现类别。
AI.research_question: 土耳其各省份的出口表现如何？能否通过聚类分析将省份按出口表现进行分类？
AI.motivation: 了解土耳其各省份的出口表现差异，为区域经济发展政策提供依据，帮助识别出口表现优异和需要改进的地区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 谱聚类理论，聚类分析方法，区域经济学中的出口表现评估框架。
AI.method: 使用2023年土耳其81个省份的进口、出口和净出口数据，采用汇率调整版本消除汇率波动影响。应用谱聚类方法，通过Eigen-Gap方法确定最优聚类数，使用Silhouette系数评估聚类性能。
AI.findings: 数据最优分为3个集群：42%省份为"低"出口表现，33%为"中"，25%为"高"。进口表现方面：44%为"中"，33%为"高"，22%为"低"。净出口表现：38%为"低"，35%为"中"，27%为"高"。伊兹密尔净出口表现最高，伊斯坦布尔最低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将谱聚类方法应用于区域出口表现分析，为区域经济聚类研究提供新方法学视角，验证了谱聚类在区域经济数据分析中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其政策制定者提供各省份出口表现的分类信息，识别需要支持的地区和表现优异的地区，为区域经济发展政策提供数据支持。

detail.abstract:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PLEASE CITE THE PUBLISHED VERSION:

Akusta, E. (2024). Does globalization promote or hinder sustainable development? Evidence from Türkiye on the three dimensions of globalization. Pamukkale University Journal of Social Sciences Institute. https://doi.org/10.30794/pausbed.1559282

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



This study analyzes the impact of globalization on sustainable development in Türkiye. We used the ARDL method with annual data for the period 2000-2021. Results reveal that economic globalization promotes positively to sustainable development in the short run with a coefficient of 0.144 and in the long run with a 0.153 coefficient. Although social globalization has a negative impact with a coefficient of-0.150 in the short run, this effect turns positive with a coefficient of 0.080 in the long run. Political globalization strongly supports sustainable development with a coefficient of 0.254 in the short run and 2.634 in the long run. Finally, total globalization has a positive impact on sustainable development in the short and long run with coefficients of 0.339 and 0.196, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用ARDL方法分析2000-2021年土耳其数据，发现经济全球化在短期和长期都对可持续发展有正向影响，社会全球化短期负向但长期转为正向，政治全球化对可持续发展支持最强，总体全球化在短期和长期都有正向影响。
AI.research_question: 全球化对土耳其的可持续发展有何影响？具体来说，经济、社会和政治三个维度的全球化分别如何影响可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 全球化与可持续发展之间的关系存在争议，需要实证研究来理解全球化对可持续发展的具体影响，特别是在土耳其这样的新兴经济体背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球化理论（特别是经济、社会和政治三个维度）和可持续发展理论，探讨全球化与可持续发展之间的理论联系。
AI.method: 使用ARDL（自回归分布滞后）方法，分析2000-2021年土耳其的年度数据，分别考察经济、社会、政治和总体全球化对可持续发展的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 经济全球化：短期系数0.144，长期系数0.153，均正向促进可持续发展
2. 社会全球化：短期系数-0.150（负向），长期系数0.080（转为正向）
3. 政治全球化：短期系数0.254，长期系数2.634，对可持续发展支持最强
4. 总体全球化：短期系数0.339，长期系数0.196，均正向影响
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了全球化三个维度对可持续发展影响的实证证据
2. 揭示了社会全球化影响的动态变化（从短期负向到长期正向）
3. 强调了政治全球化在促进可持续发展中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为土耳其政策制定者提供了全球化政策设计的依据
2. 建议关注社会全球化的短期调整成本，但重视其长期积极影响
3. 强调政治全球化在推动可持续发展中的战略重要性

detail.abstract: This paper is a theoretical study of the distribution of future investment returns with a stop-loss. It derives explicit analytical formulae for the variance, Sharp ratio, semivariance and expected shortfall under the assumption of a geometric Brownian motion.

AI.tldr: 该论文推导了在几何布朗运动假设下，带止损策略的未来投资回报分布的方差、夏普比率、半方差和期望短缺的显式解析公式。
AI.research_question: 在几何布朗运动假设下，带止损策略的未来投资回报分布的特征（方差、夏普比率、半方差、期望短缺）的解析表达式是什么？
AI.motivation: 止损策略在投资管理中广泛应用，但对其回报分布特征的解析理解有限。现有研究缺乏对带止损策略回报分布风险度量的显式公式推导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何布朗运动（GBM）模型，随机过程理论，投资组合风险管理理论，止损策略理论
AI.method: 理论推导方法，基于几何布朗运动的随机微分方程解析求解，概率分布函数推导，风险度量公式推导
AI.findings: 推导出了带止损策略的未来投资回报分布的方差、夏普比率、半方差和期望短缺的显式解析公式，为风险管理提供了精确的计算工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统推导了在GBM假设下带止损策略回报分布的风险度量解析公式，填补了该领域理论空白，为后续研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资经理提供了精确计算止损策略风险特征的工具，有助于优化止损水平设定，改进风险管理决策，提高投资组合绩效评估的准确性。

title: A Simple Trading Strategy with a Stop-Loss and Take-Profit Order

detail.title: A Simple Trading Strategy with a Stop-Loss and Take-Profit Order
detail.abstract: We study the optimal placement of a stop-loss in a simple trading strategy with a stop-loss and take-profit order. We show that there are conditions under which a stop-loss increases the mean return and reduces its variance. We present a simple, approximate formula for the optimal level of the stop-loss, similar to the Kelly criterion for position sizing.

AI.tldr: 研究在带有止损和止盈的简单交易策略中，如何最优设置止损水平。发现特定条件下止损能提高平均收益并降低方差，提出了类似凯利准则的近似最优止损公式。
AI.research_question: 在带有止损和止盈的简单交易策略中，如何确定最优的止损水平？
AI.motivation: 止损是交易中常用的风险管理工具，但如何设置最优止损水平缺乏理论指导。现有研究多关注止损是否有效，而非如何量化最优止损点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于概率论和随机过程理论，分析止损对收益分布的影响；借鉴凯利准则的最优化思想，构建止损水平的最优决策框架。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：建立包含止损和止盈的交易策略数学模型，分析止损水平对收益均值和方差的影响，推导最优止损条件的解析解。
AI.findings: 1. 存在特定条件使得止损能同时提高平均收益并降低方差；2. 提出了类似凯利准则的简单近似公式来计算最优止损水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统分析止损对收益分布的双重影响；2. 建立了止损最优化的理论框架；3. 提出了类似凯利准则的止损设置准则。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为交易者提供了量化设置止损的理论依据；2. 简化了最优止损的计算方法；3. 帮助交易者平衡收益与风险。
