detail.title: Fashion Revolution in Italy: An Exploration of Gen Z’s Approach to Activism in the Fast-fashion Industry

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Palgrave Handbook of Consumerism Issues in the Apparel Industry | ISBN 978-3-031-59951-4 | 2024 | DOI: 10.1007/978-3-031-59952-1

detail.abstract: This chapter examines Italian Generation Z’s approach to consumer activism in the fast-fashion industry and explores how empowerment and dialogic practices by activist movements—most notably Fashion Revolution—and other stakeholders can catalyze collective action for social change. We adopt a mixed-methods design: an élite interview with Marina Spadafora, founder and country coordinator of Fashion Revolution Italy, informed the development of a nationwide survey administered to 1,428 Gen Z respondents across Northern, Central, and Southern Italy between January and March 2023. Results show limited familiarity with the Movement (76.9%) and a tendency to perceive social consequences of fast fashion as more pressing than environmental ones. Notably, 67.8% would stop purchasing from brands deemed irresponsible, yet 82% would not abandon fast fashion as a category, signaling a persistent intention–behavior gap. Interest in empowerment is high, with 70.8% willing to learn more and attend meetings with activists. Reliability thresholds were met (all scales α > .70), and correlations were positive between awareness and activism (r = .580) and between activism and willingness to become activists (r = .638).

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了意大利Z世代对快时尚消费行动主义的态度，发现尽管对Fashion Revolution运动了解有限，但Z世代更关注快时尚的社会影响而非环境问题，存在明显的意图-行为差距，但对赋权和参与行动主义活动表现出较高兴趣。
AI.research_question: 意大利Z世代如何参与快时尚行业的消费行动主义？Fashion Revolution等行动主义运动的赋权和对话实践如何促进社会变革的集体行动？
AI.motivation: 快时尚行业的环境和社会影响日益受到关注，Z世代作为重要消费群体，其行动主义态度和行为对推动行业变革具有关键作用。需要了解这一代人对消费行动主义的认知、态度和参与意愿。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费行动主义理论、集体行动理论、赋权理论、意图-行为差距理论、社会变革理论
AI.method: 混合方法设计：1）对Fashion Revolution意大利创始人Marina Spadafora进行精英访谈；2）2023年1-3月对意大利北部、中部和南部的1,428名Z世代受访者进行全国性问卷调查
AI.findings: 1）对Fashion Revolution运动的了解有限（76.9%不熟悉）；2）更关注快时尚的社会后果而非环境后果；3）67.8%会停止购买不负责任的品牌，但82%不会放弃快时尚类别，存在意图-行为差距；4）70.8%愿意学习更多并参加活动家会议；5）认知与行动主义呈正相关（r=0.580），行动主义与成为活动家的意愿呈正相关（r=0.638）
AI.theory_contributions: 1）深化了Z世代消费行动主义的理解；2）验证了意图-行为差距在快时尚消费中的存在；3）揭示了赋权实践对集体行动的催化作用；4）为消费行动主义理论提供了代际视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为Fashion Revolution等组织提供针对Z世代的沟通策略建议；2）帮助品牌了解年轻消费者的行动主义态度；3）为政策制定者提供促进可持续消费的参考；4）为教育工作者设计相关课程提供依据

title: AI Personalization, Service Quality, and Brand Loyalty in Cross-Border Fast-Food E-Commerce: The Mediating Role of Consumer Trust and the Moderating Role of Personality Traits

detail.title: AI Personalization, Service Quality, and Brand Loyalty in Cross-Border Fast-Food E-Commerce: The Mediating Role of Consumer Trust and the Moderating Role of Personality Traits

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study involved a questionnaire completed by customers. No formal ethics approval was required by my institution, but the study complied with all applicable ethical guidelines.

detail.abstract: Service quality together with artificial intelligence (AI)-driven personalization functions as a dual force which determines consumer loyalty in digital commerce development. The research investigates how AI personalization affects the connection between service quality and brand loyalty in fast-food e-commerce operations that span across international borders. The research demonstrates how service quality impacts brand loyalty through consumer trust using Trust Theory and Big-Five personality framework while showing personality traits affect this relationship. Data were collected from 420 consumers (210 from Pakistan and 210 from the UAE) through structured online surveys and analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The research indicates that AI personalization creates consumer trust when brands demonstrate transparency and responsibility and consumers demonstrate their highest loyalty to brands. The research results enhance servicemarketing theory while providing businesses with operational methods to create dependable technological marketing approaches for their international fast-food businesses.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了AI个性化如何影响服务质量与品牌忠诚度之间的关系，特别是在跨国快餐电商中。研究发现AI个性化通过建立消费者信任来增强品牌忠诚度，且人格特质调节这一关系。
AI.research_question: AI个性化如何影响服务质量与品牌忠诚度之间的关系？特别是在跨国快餐电商环境中，消费者信任和人格特质如何调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 随着数字商务的发展，服务质量和AI驱动的个性化成为决定消费者忠诚度的双重力量。研究需要理解在跨国快餐电商运营中，AI个性化如何影响服务质量与品牌忠诚度的联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任理论和大五人格框架。信任理论用于解释服务质量如何通过消费者信任影响品牌忠诚度；大五人格框架用于分析人格特质如何调节这一关系。
AI.method: 从巴基斯坦和阿联酋各收集210名消费者数据（共420份），通过结构化在线问卷调查收集数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行分析。
AI.findings: AI个性化在品牌展示透明度和责任感时能够建立消费者信任，进而增强品牌忠诚度。人格特质影响服务质量、信任和忠诚度之间的关系。消费者对展示透明度和责任感的品牌表现出最高忠诚度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了服务营销理论，整合了AI个性化、信任和人格特质因素；2. 在跨国电商环境中验证了服务质量-信任-忠诚度关系；3. 将大五人格框架应用于数字商务忠诚度研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供了创建可靠技术营销方法的操作指南；2. 强调了品牌透明度和责任感在AI个性化中的重要性；3. 为跨国快餐企业提供了基于消费者人格特质的差异化营销策略。

title: Persistent Post-Cartel Effects: Evidence of Lasting Impact on the Years After Collusion
affiliations: ,  and School of Economics - University of Navarra and IESE Business School

detail.title: Persistent Post-Cartel Effects: Evidence of Lasting Impact on the Years After Collusion

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: Germán López-Espinosa acknowledges financial assistance from the research project PID2022-136451NB-100 funded by the Spanish Ministry of Economics, Industry, and Competitiveness.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the cartel's effects persist after the sanction period ends. We use the JATO database to construct transaction-level prices for identical car models in a cartel-affected market (Spain) and a comparable benchmark market (Germany) that was not subject to the cartel. Tracking pre-, during-, and post-sanction periods at a highly granular product level allows us to directly test whether overcharges persist once sanctions are lifted-an empirical setting in which the literature has long warned of bias yet has lacked cross-market, model-matched transaction data. Our results show that cartel firms behave strategically: because the expected legal costs are higher if they abruptly reduce the overcharge, the effects of the cartel persist in subsequent years, resulting in additional costs for consumers. Furthermore, we propose an easy-to-compute aggregate measure to assess whether prices are synchronized across different markets, which can be used to detect anomalous pricing behavior at an aggregate level.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了卡特尔效应在制裁期结束后是否持续存在。通过使用JATO数据库构建西班牙（受影响市场）和德国（基准市场）相同车型的交易级价格数据，追踪制裁前、中、后三个时期，发现卡特尔企业行为具有战略性：由于突然降低超额收费的预期法律成本更高，卡特尔效应在后续年份持续存在，给消费者带来额外成本。同时提出了一个易于计算的聚合度量来检测跨市场价格同步性。
AI.research_question: 卡特尔效应在制裁期结束后是否持续存在？
AI.motivation: 现有文献长期警告存在偏差，但缺乏跨市场、模型匹配的交易数据来实证检验制裁解除后超额收费是否持续存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业战略行为理论，特别是预期法律成本对定价决策的影响。卡特尔企业考虑突然降低超额收费可能带来的法律风险，因此选择维持较高价格。
AI.method: 使用JATO数据库构建交易级价格数据，比较西班牙（卡特尔受影响市场）和德国（基准市场）相同车型的价格。采用三重差分法追踪制裁前、中、后三个时期，进行高度细化的产品层面分析。
AI.findings: 卡特尔效应在制裁期结束后持续存在。卡特尔企业行为具有战略性：由于突然降低超额收费的预期法律成本更高，超额收费在后续年份继续存在，导致消费者承担额外成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了卡特尔制裁后效应持续存在的实证证据；2) 揭示了企业战略行为在定价决策中的作用；3) 提出了预期法律成本影响企业定价的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构提供了检测卡特尔后效应的实证工具；2) 提出了易于计算的聚合度量来检测跨市场价格同步性；3) 帮助消费者了解卡特尔制裁后的持续成本影响。

detail.abstract:
Abstract
Social media in B2B business development has received limited academic attention compared to its extensive treatment in B2C contexts. This doctoral research examines how social media influences the B2B business development process within global software solutions and services firms. Using a mixed-methods design grounded in post-positivism, the study develops and tests a conceptual model informed by relationship marketing, information systems theory, social capital, and usage criteria.
The research combines qualitative insights from expert interviews across functions, industries, and regions with a large-scale cross-sectional survey of more than 530 practitioners drawn from LinkedIn and XING. Measurement instruments were derived from existing literature and refined through exploratory and confirmatory analyses, including thematic analysis and structural equation modelling.
The findings suggest that digital and social media accelerate the B2B business development process cycle: by enhancing visibility, strengthening relational ties, and supporting cross-functional cooperation. Social media acts as a subsidiary technology that reduces information asymmetry and improves perceived business performance, though its impact should not be overstated. The study contributes a parsimonious, innovative model that integrates social media into B2B business development, highlights the moderating role of social capital, and proposes new constructs, including the Social Business Relevance and Social Business Motivation Indices. Managerial implications include classifying B2B developers into social media advocates, mixed types, and sceptics, and offering guidelines to render business development operations more agile and collaborative.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨社交媒体如何影响全球软件解决方案和服务公司的B2B业务发展过程，发现社交媒体通过增强可见性、加强关系纽带和支持跨职能合作来加速B2B业务发展周期，但不应过分夸大其影响。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体如何影响全球软件解决方案和服务公司的B2B业务发展过程？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体在B2B业务发展中的学术关注度远低于B2C环境，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系营销理论、信息系统理论、社会资本理论和使用标准理论
AI.method: 混合方法设计（后实证主义基础），结合跨职能、行业和地区的专家访谈定性洞察，以及从LinkedIn和XING抽取的530多名从业者的大规模横断面调查
AI.findings: 数字和社交媒体通过增强可见性、加强关系纽带和支持跨职能合作来加速B2B业务发展周期；社交媒体作为辅助技术减少信息不对称并改善感知业务绩效，但其影响不应被夸大
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个简约创新的模型，将社交媒体整合到B2B业务发展中；强调了社会资本的调节作用；提出了新的构念，包括社交业务相关性指数和社交业务动机指数
AI.practical_contributions: 将B2B开发者分为社交媒体倡导者、混合型和怀疑者三类；提供指导方针使业务发展运营更加敏捷和协作

title: AI as a Catalyst: Uncovering the Effects of AI Assistance on Review Generation and Engagement
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Marketing

detail.title: AI as a Catalyst: Uncovering the Effects of AI Assistance on Review Generation and Engagement
detail.abstract: Public opinion is vital for societies and markets, yet the "silent majority" often hesitates to share views. This study examines how generative AI can facilitate opinion expression. Building on a custom video platform, we experimentally tested two formats of AI assistance powered by large language models: a one-click generation from user-provided keywords or prompts, and an interactive chatbot for collaborative drafting. Four key findings emerge. First, AI assistance boosts comment rates by 15.19% over the plain control without AI. This effect is particularly pronounced among those typically reluctant to review online. Second, AI-assisted comments exhibit systematic positive sentiment bias. Third, with a follow-up study to solicit genuine opinions of the same users, we find that, surprisingly, AI-assisted comments are more semantically similar to these genuine opinions (via text embeddings). Fourth, we find that these AI-assisted comments can drive downstream user engagement via richer informational content. To explain these findings, we propose, and find evidence for, a sequential model of the cognitive writing process: users articulate aspects of their opinion with costly effort and may stop early; AI enhances efficiency by helping users expand the key aspects for expression, despite biased sentiment. These results highlight generative AI's potential to promote broader, authentic opinion sharing and consumer engagement, while noting bias risks for platform design.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨生成式AI如何促进意见表达，通过实验发现AI辅助能提升评论率15.19%，尤其帮助沉默群体发声，但会引入情感偏见；AI辅助评论与用户真实意见语义更接近，且能驱动更多用户参与。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何促进在线意见表达？AI辅助对评论率、情感倾向、意见真实性以及用户参与度有何影响？
AI.motivation: 公共意见对社会和市场至关重要，但"沉默的大多数"往往不愿分享观点。需要探索如何利用新技术降低表达门槛，促进更广泛、真实的意见交流。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知写作过程的序列模型：用户需要付出认知努力来阐述观点，可能因成本过高而提前停止；AI通过帮助用户扩展关键表达方面来提高效率。
AI.method: 在定制视频平台上进行实验研究，测试两种AI辅助格式：1）基于用户提供关键词或提示的一键生成；2）用于协作草拟的交互式聊天机器人。随后进行后续研究收集相同用户的真实意见。
AI.findings: 1) AI辅助使评论率提升15.19%，对通常不愿在线评论的人群效果更明显；2) AI辅助评论存在系统性积极情感偏见；3) AI辅助评论与用户真实意见语义更相似；4) AI辅助评论通过更丰富的信息内容驱动下游用户参与。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了认知写作过程的序列模型，解释了AI如何通过降低表达成本促进意见表达；揭示了AI辅助下意见表达的真实性与情感偏见并存的现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计提供指导：生成式AI可促进更广泛、真实的意见分享和消费者参与，但需注意情感偏见风险；特别有助于沉默群体的发声。

title: Crop Productivity in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and University of Yaounde II

detail.title: Crop Productivity in Sub-Saharan Africa

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides new cross-country evidence that greater investment in agricultural R&D significantly mitigates the adverse effects of climate variability on crop yields in sub-Saharan Africa. Despite this critical role, only a handful of countries have invested at levels sufficient to reach the thresholds where R&D delivers effective risk adaptation. Our analysis indicates that closing this gap would require an additional US$1–3 billion in annual agricultural research investment across the region.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，增加农业研发投资能显著缓解气候变化对撒哈拉以南非洲作物产量的负面影响，但只有少数国家达到有效风险适应的投资门槛，需每年增加10-30亿美元投资来缩小差距。
AI.research_question: 农业研发投资如何影响气候变化对撒哈拉以南非洲作物产量的影响？需要多少额外投资才能达到有效的风险适应水平？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对撒哈拉以南非洲的农业生产力构成严重威胁，而农业研发投资可能提供重要的适应机制，但目前投资水平不足，需要量化其效果和投资缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业创新和气候变化适应理论，探讨研发投资作为风险缓解机制的作用，以及投资门槛效应的存在。
AI.method: 跨国比较分析，使用计量经济学方法评估农业研发投资与气候变化对作物产量影响的交互效应，并计算投资缺口。
AI.findings: 1) 农业研发投资显著减轻气候变化对作物产量的负面影响；2) 只有少数国家达到有效风险适应的投资门槛；3) 整个地区需要每年额外10-30亿美元投资来缩小差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证了农业研发作为气候变化适应机制的理论；2) 识别了研发投资的门槛效应；3) 提供了跨国比较的证据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了具体的投资目标（10-30亿美元/年）；2) 强调了需要优先投资农业研发以应对气候变化；3) 为国际援助和发展机构提供了决策依据。
